* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters. Promote and embed a culture of openness, trust and risk awareness where ethical, legal, regulatory and policy complaint conduct is the norm


**Governance**
* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, around infrastructure hosting and data management for client facing applications, and the regulatory requirements and expectations for the Bank. Ensure application design considerations are taken based on this.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters. Promote and embed a culture of openness, trust and risk awareness where ethical, legal, regulatory and policy complaint conduct is the norm.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Skills And Experience**
* Strong proficiency in backend development using Python or Golang, Solidity, RESTful API design, and microservice architectures
* DLT Use Cases: Demonstrated understanding of DLT applications such as Real\-World Asset (RWA) tokenization, Cross\-Border Payments, Decentralized Identity (DID), and smart contract\-based financial products.
* DevOps \& Deployment: Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. Proven track record deploying systems on AWS EKS or Azure AKS using CI/CD pipelines.
* Cryptography \& Security: Knowledge of cryptographic primitives including public/private key infrastructure, symmetric/asymmetric encryption, digital signatures, and secure key management.
* Blockchain Platforms: Hands\-on experience with permissioned blockchain frameworks such as Quorum, Hyperledger Besu, Hyperledger Fabric, and Corda, including provisioning, configuration, and orchestration.


**Qualifications**
* Masters or Engineering background


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

**Qualifications**
**Must Have**
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one PIM platform: Akeneo, InRiver, Salsify, or equivalent.
* Deep understanding of product data modeling — attribute families, completeness metrics, variant/SKU hierarchies, and category trees.
* Experience building PIM\-to\-Commerce integrations (Adobe Commerce, VTEX, Salesforce Commerce, etc.).
* Proficiency with REST / GraphQL APIs for data ingestion and syndication.
* Experience with ERP integration (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) for pricing, inventory, and product master data.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with catalog APIs or Adobe Commerce catalog modules.
* Knowledge of DAM systems and media asset enrichment workflows.
* Familiarity with ETL tools (MuleSoft, Boomi).
* Understanding of B2B catalog scenarios: customer\-specific pricing, entitlements, and product visibility rules.
* Exposure to data governance frameworks and MDM concepts.


**Key Differentiators for This Role**
* PIM platform configuration and administration not just integration.
* Ownership of product data quality and enrichment workflows end\-to\-end.
* Ability to bridge business/merchandising teams and technical engineering teams.

* Metadata Management \& Data Governance

* Experience with Databricks on AWS or GCP.

title: AI Quality Engineer, Safety and RAG - Assistant Vice President
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering — from
 **Agentic AI flow testing** 
 and
 **RAG pipeline validation** 
 to
 **AI safety, test automation** 
 , and
 **performance \& reliability engineering** 
 .
   

  

 You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are
 **safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production\-ready** 
 at scale. This is a high\-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Agentic AI Testing
   

  

* Design and execute end\-to\-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single\-agent and multi\-agent workflows.
* Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision\-making chains (e.g., ReAct, Chain\-of\-Thought, Plan\-and\-Execute, Reflexion).
* Test tool\-use correctness — ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time.
* Evaluate agent memory systems (short\-term, long\-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions.
* Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi\-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph).
* Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops.


 RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) Testing
   

  

* Design comprehensive test strategies for end\-to\-end RAG pipelines — covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages.
* Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance — ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query.
* Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora.
* Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval.
* Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality.
* Validate context window management — ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality.
* Conduct end\-to\-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes.
* Test multi\-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns.


 Test Automation
   

  

* Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation.
* Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation.
* Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data.
* Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes.
* Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM\-based decisions.
* Automate vector database validation — index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks.


**AI Safety \& Security Testing**
* Conduct red\-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM\-based systems.
* Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out\-of\-scope model behavior.
* Validate privilege escalation controls — ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources.
* Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness.
* Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas.
* Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies.
* Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including:
+ Prompt Injection (Direct \& Indirect)
+ Insecure Output Handling
+ Training Data Poisoning
+ Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
+ Sensitive Information Disclosure

* Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF\-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI\-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management.
* Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red\-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations.


 Performance \& Reliability Testing
   

  

* Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI\-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services.
* Measure and optimize end\-to\-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines — from query to final response.
* Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure.
* Test auto\-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions.
* Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation.
* Test vector database performance — query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency.
* Conduct cost efficiency analysis — measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task.
* Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99\), and error rates.
* Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems.
* Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures.


 Domain Knowledge
   

  

* Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns — naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG.
* Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan\-and\-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture\-of\-Agents.
* Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers).
* Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization.
* Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards.
* Exposure to multi\-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents).
* Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos).


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Master’s degree is a plus.


**Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI.
* Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non\-deterministic AI systems.
* Strong background in performance testing and AI safety/security assessments.

 tuning/optimization of Oracle EBS systems for recoverability, security, confidentiality, and integrity to
   

 ensure that: EBS applications and database configurations meet Oracle ERP goals, Oracle EBS
   

 requirements, and Staples standards; patches are applied on a timely basis; data integrity and security are
   

 maintained; backups are performed as scheduled or deemed necessary; and upgrades are made. Utilize
   

 Oracle EBS R12 applications DBA (AD) utilities to perform maintenance of the multi\-node e\-Business
   

 Suite environment with Shared File System, managing and administering Concurrent Managers,
   

 Concurrent Programs, Request Sets, Request Groups, Workflows, and troubleshooting Workflow
   

 Mailer/Notification issues; Oracle Real Applications Clusters (RAC) to maintain a clustered database to
   

 provide performance, scalability, and resilience with Automatic Storage Management (ASM) and Cluster
   

 Ready Services (CRS) in an AIX/Linux operating system (O/S); Oracle Recovery Manager (RMAN) and
   

 Data Guard for backup and disaster recovery; Oracle Application Manager (OAM) and Oracle Enterprise
   

 Manager (OEM) Grid Control for proactive monitoring and notification of system status; and Procedural
   

 Language/Structured Query Language (PL/SQL) packages, Shell, and Perl scripts for task automation.
   

 Proactively monitor, test, and report on Oracle EBS system integrity, security, and compliance measures.
   

 Identify opportunities to upgrade or replace software to meet the current and future requirements of
   

 business areas and end\-users. Recommend changes and participate in the implementation and follow\-up
   

 management of upgrades or replacements. Evaluate critical Oracle EBS security issues and make
   

 recommendations, such as disaster recovery plans and upgrades to new versions of Oracle EBS R12 or
   

 successor releases.
   

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

 Required Experience/Skills: Requires a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Computer
   

 Science, or a directly related field plus 10\+ years of progressive experience in Oracle Financials
   

 infrastructure administration. Experience must include:
   

 10\+ years of experience in the following (experience may be gained concurrently):
   

 • Hands\-on experience as an Oracle Applications DBA.
   

 • System analysis and design involving, data flow diagrams; data dictionary techniques; CASE tools;
   

 entity\-relation modeling and design techniques; database troubleshooting; data warehouse concepts;
   

 and installing and upgrading the Oracle server and application tools.
   

 • Working with physical disk storage involving understanding of disk hardware architecture; RAID
   

 implementation; cache controllers; and disk load balancing.
   

 • Relational database security including role\-based security, including experience with Unix,
   

 Windows, ODBC, JDBC, Shell scripting.
   

 • Installation, upgrade, patching, and support of Oracle databases 11g or 12c.
   

 • Oracle e\-Business Suite R12 administration.
   

 • Working with physical disk storage involving system storage planning or fine tuning.
   

 • Backup and recovery methods including Veritas, Legato, or ADSM

title: Senior Engineer - Controls
description:
**About Us:**
 Barry\-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper\-converting industries. By blending people\-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose\-driven growth, Barry\-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
   

  

 What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well\-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
   

  

 In India, Barry\-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
   

  

**Our culture is built on:**
* Ownership – Drive features end\-to\-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.


**Career Development and Global Exposure**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting\-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
   

  

 If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high\-impact, future\-focused environment—where long\-term stability meets start\-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Engineer – Controls** 
 with 8\+ years of experience in the design, development, modification, migration, integration, and implementation of
 **PLC and HMI/SCADA systems for discrete machinery and equipment** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with a combination of
 **Siemens, Allen\-Bradley (Rockwell Automation), and Beckhoff** 
 automation platforms. Experience in
 **printing, paper converting, packaging, textile, or other machinery/OEM industries** 
 is highly preferred.
   

  

 The engineer should be able to take a systems approach to understand the overall machine design, mechanical functions, electrical architecture, control philosophy, safety systems, and automation requirements, and develop robust PLC and HMI programs ensuring the overall functional quality and performance of the machinery/equipment.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for the interface between
 **electrical hardware, PLC software, HMI/SCADA, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, and machine\-level automation** 
 .
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

 PLC \& HMI Platforms
   

  

 Strong hands\-on experience in one or more of the following platforms, with the ability to work across multiple automation platforms:
   

  

* Siemens S7\-1200 / S7\-1500 PLCs
* Siemens Comfort Panels / Unified Comfort Panels
* Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Automation PLCs
+ ControlLogix
+ CompactLogix

* Beckhoff PLC / IPC\-based control systems
+ TwinCAT 3
+ EtherCAT

* Experience with HMI/SCADA development and integration across Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms.


 PLC \& HMI Development
   

  

* Hands\-on experience developing PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on URS, functional specifications, and client standards.
* Ability to understand and develop PLC programs using:
+ Ladder Logic
+ Function Block Diagram
+ Structured Text
+ Sequential Function Chart

* Develop machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, permissives, recipes, diagnostics, and operator interfaces.
* Interface PLC programs with HMI/SCADA systems.
* Experience in modifying, debugging, migrating, and optimizing existing PLC/HMI programs.
* Experience with machine\-level automation and discrete manufacturing applications.
* HMI scripting/programming experience using JavaScript, C\#, or similar technologies is an added advantage.


 Siemens Automation
   

  

* Strong hands\-on experience with Siemens S7\-1500 PLCs.
* Experience with TIA Portal V15\.1 or above.
* TIA Portal V17/V18/V19 or later experience preferred.
* Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development.
* PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging.
* Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred.


 Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Automation
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with Allen\-Bradley PLCs.
* Experience with ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix platforms.
* Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience.
* Allen\-Bradley HMI experience using FactoryTalk View is preferred.
* Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage.


 Beckhoff Automation
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with Beckhoff PLC/control systems.
* Experience with TwinCAT 3 programming and development.
* Knowledge of EtherCAT communication and distributed I/O systems.
* Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred.
* Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage.


 Industrial Communication \& Networking
   

  

 Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including:
   

  

* PROFINET / PROFIBUS
* EtherNet/IP
* EtherCAT
* AS\-i
* CAN / CANopen
* DeviceNet
* Modbus TCP/RTU
* OPC UA
* Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols


 Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks.
   

  

 Drives, Motors \& Motion Control
   

  

* Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion\-control systems.
* Understanding of:
+ Motor horsepower
+ Torque
+ Speed range
+ Gear ratios
+ Reduction ratios
+ Acceleration/deceleration

* Experience with Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred.
* Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion\-control applications.


 Instrumentation \& Control Components
   

  

 Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including:
   

  

* Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc.
* Digital and analog sensors
* Proximity and photoelectric sensors
* Encoders
* Transducers
* Solenoid valves
* Relays
* Contactors
* On/Off control devices
* Analog I/O and signal conditioning
* A/D and D/A conversion
* I/P and P/I conversion


 Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects.
   

  

 FAT, SAT \& Commissioning
   

  

* Develop automation test cases and procedures for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
* Participate in FAT/SAT with customers and project teams.
* Hands\-on experience in machine installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and start\-up.
* Ability to troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, I/O, communication, and machine sequence issues.
* Experience with remote commissioning and troubleshooting tools.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites for commissioning and project support.


 Standards \& Compliance
   

  

 Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as:
   

  

* ANSI
* ISA
* NEC
* NEMA
* NFPA
* OSHA
* UL


 Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage.
   

  

 Tool Skills
   

  

 Mandatory / Core
   

  

* Siemens TIA Portal – V15\.1 or above
* Siemens S7\-1500 PLC
* Siemens Comfort / Unified Comfort HMI
* Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell Studio 5000
* ControlLogix / CompactLogix
* Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
* EtherCAT


**Preferred**
* TIA Portal V17\+
* FactoryTalk View
* Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff drives and motion systems
* OPC UA
* Industrial Ethernet networking
* HMI scripting / C\# / JavaScript
* EPLAN or similar electrical engineering tools


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience in PLC and HMI programming.
* Experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience developing PLC/HMI programs from scratch.
* Experience in machinery/OEM applications is highly preferred.
* Experience in printing, packaging, paper converting, textile, or other discrete machinery industries is an advantage.
* Experience in machine commissioning and customer\-site support is preferred.


 Key Result Areas
   

  

* Configure automation hardware and software according to project design specifications.
* Develop PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on machine automation requirements.
* Integrate Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, and Beckhoff automation platforms with machine hardware and control systems.
* Ensure optimal performance, reliability, quality, and responsiveness of PLC/HMI applications.
* Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, motion, I/O, and industrial communication issues.
* Follow software development, change\-management, and version\-control procedures.
* Maintain proper documentation of PLC/HMI software and project changes.
* Manage assigned projects and deliver according to agreed schedules and scope.
* Communicate project progress, technical issues, and risks to project stakeholders.
* Support FAT, SAT, machine start\-up, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
* Provide technical support to internal teams and customers as required.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Logical and systematic approach to problem\-solving.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Ability to understand complex machine sequences and identify key technical issues.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
* Strong customer\-facing and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing project requirements.
* Willingness to learn and work across multiple automation platforms.


 Travel
   

  

 Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required, up to
 **15%** 
 , for customer meetings, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project support.
   

  

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
 The ideal candidate will be a
 **multi\-platform Controls Engineer** 
 with strong practical experience in:
   

  

**Siemens \+ Allen\-Bradley \+ Beckhoff**
 with hands\-on capability in:
   

  

**PLC Programming → HMI Development → Drives/Motion → Industrial Communication → Machine Integration → FAT/SAT → Commissioning**
 Experience with
 **OEM/discrete machinery** 
 , particularly printing, packaging, paper converting, or textile machinery, will be a strong advantage.
   

  

 Barry\-Wehmiller is committed to creating a people\-centric workplace where employees can bring their best selves to the work they do and grow through meaningful career opportunities.
   

  

*At Barry\-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*

description:

**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

**Role Definition**
 Reliable equipment information transmission is critical to provide high\-quality Condition Monitoring services. In this role, you will enable this two ways: first by establishing the sources of machine data, and secondly by making sure connections are maintained to monitor the health of customers’ fleets. You will do this via global customer deployments, asset enrollments, as well as telematics\-related projects, analysis, and maintenance activities.

* Perform connectivity readiness assessments and resolve pre\-deployment issues

 situations.

 as the guiding principle.

**Technical Troubleshooting:** 
 Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation as it relates to telematics systems.

**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a Senior SAP BTP Developer with strong hands\-on experience in SAP CAP/CAPM, BTP, Node.js/Java, and multi\-tenant application development. The candidate should have good understanding of Clean Core principles, BTP services, system design, Infrastructure as Code, and modern AI\-assisted development practices.

 • Design and develop scalable applications using SAP BTP and SAP CAP/CAPM.

title: Senior Power BI Developer
description:
**About Metayb**
 Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital\-first era. We have grown into a close\-knit family of
 **500\+ employees** 
 , each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital\-first ecosystem of value creation.
   

  

 Our key areas of expertise lie in
 **Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance, and Supply Chain Services** 
 . We strongly aspire to venture into
 **IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality** 
 . Metayb endeavours to be best\-in\-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior Power BI Developer** 
 to take ownership of the design, development, and optimisation of enterprise\-level business intelligence and analytics solutions.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that involves working across the complete analytics lifecycle — from preparing and transforming data to building
 **semantic models, developing Power BI reports, defining business metrics, optimising performance, and supporting solutions in production** 
 .
   

  

 The role requires someone who can go beyond report development and understand how data, business requirements, modelling, and visualisation come together to create reliable and scalable analytics solutions. You will work closely with
 **business stakeholders, data engineers, analysts, and technology teams** 
 to translate business requirements into meaningful insights and high\-quality reporting solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in
 **Power BI, advanced DAX, SQL, data modelling, Power Query, PySpark, and Microsoft Fabric** 
 , along with strong problem\-solving and stakeholder management skills. The candidate will also be expected to contribute to technical standards, improve existing analytics solutions, and mentor junior members of the team.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🔹 Power BI Development \& Analytics
   

  

* Lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
* Own the complete reporting lifecycle, from understanding business requirements and preparing data to development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Develop reporting solutions for different levels of the organisation, ranging from detailed operational dashboards to management and executive\-level reporting.
* Build dashboards that present complex information in a clear, meaningful, and easy\-to\-understand manner.
* Ensure reporting solutions are accurate, consistent, scalable, and aligned with defined business requirements.
* Review existing Power BI solutions and identify opportunities to improve functionality, usability, performance, and maintainability.


 🔹 Data Modelling \& Semantic Models
   

  

* Design robust and reusable semantic models using star\-schema and dimensional modelling principles.
* Define appropriate fact and dimension structures, relationships, hierarchies, and business logic.
* Work with different modelling and storage approaches, including Import, DirectQuery, Composite, and Direct Lake, based on business and technical requirements.
* Ensure models are designed for scalability, performance, and ease of use by report developers and business users.
* Apply sound judgement when deciding between different modelling approaches, including when denormalisation may be appropriate.
* Maintain clear documentation around data models, business logic, KPIs, and reporting definitions.


 🔹 DAX \& Business Calculations
   

  

* Develop and maintain advanced DAX measures, calculated logic, and calculation groups for complex business requirements.
* Build calculations covering areas such as time intelligence, period comparisons, trends, rankings, and business KPIs.
* Apply advanced DAX concepts including filter context, row context, context transition, CALCULATE, iterators, and variables.
* Review and optimise existing DAX calculations to improve report performance and responsiveness.
* Ensure business calculations are consistent and accurately reflect agreed business definitions and requirements.


 🔹 Data Preparation \& Transformation
   

  

* Work with data from multiple sources and prepare it for reporting using Power Query, SQL, and PySpark.
* Develop and maintain transformation logic required to create reliable and analytics\-ready datasets.
* Work with data engineering teams to ensure the availability, quality, and structure of data required for reporting.
* Support the development of curated datasets across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.
* Work with structured and semi\-structured data and ensure it is appropriately prepared for analytical use.
* Identify data quality issues and work with relevant teams to resolve them at the appropriate stage of the data lifecycle.


 🔹 Microsoft Fabric \& Modern Data Platforms
   

  

* Work hands\-on with the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem to build and support modern analytics solutions.
* Develop and maintain Fabric components including Lakehouses, Notebooks, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Direct Lake semantic models.
* Work with OneLake and curated datasets to support enterprise reporting and analytics.
* Contribute to modern lakehouse\-based analytics architecture and the integration of Fabric with Power BI.
* Support the adoption of scalable and reusable approaches to data preparation, modelling, and reporting within the Fabric environment.
* Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure the analytics layer is effectively integrated with the underlying data platform.


 🔹 SQL \& PySpark
   

  

* Develop and optimise SQL queries for reporting and analytical workloads, including working with large datasets.
* Use joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and query optimisation techniques to build efficient data solutions.
* Develop and maintain PySpark transformation logic using DataFrame operations, joins, aggregations, and window functions.
* Work with semi\-structured data where required and ensure transformation processes are scalable.
* Identify inefficient queries or transformation processes and recommend improvements to enhance overall data processing performance.


 🔹 Performance Optimisation
   

  

* Take ownership of performance across Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX calculations, data refreshes, and underlying transformation processes.
* Diagnose and resolve issues relating to slow visuals, inefficient DAX, oversized models, long\-running refreshes, and inefficient data processing.
* Review model design, query performance, calculations, and refresh processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Use appropriate tools such as DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, ALM Toolkit, and Best Practice Analyzer when analysing and resolving performance issues.
* Establish good development and performance practices that can be adopted across the wider analytics team.


 🔹 Power BI Service, Security \& Deployment
   

  

* Manage and support Power BI environments, including workspaces, gateways, deployment pipelines, datasets, and scheduled refreshes.
* Implement and troubleshoot Row\-Level Security (RLS) and workspace access requirements.
* Support the controlled movement of reports and semantic models across development, testing, and production environments.
* Monitor scheduled refreshes and troubleshoot refresh failures, access issues, and dataset\-related problems.
* Ensure Power BI solutions follow appropriate security, governance, and deployment practices.
* Support the team in maintaining a consistent and controlled Power BI environment.


 🔹 Business Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Work directly with business stakeholders to understand their reporting requirements, business challenges, and analytical objectives.
* Translate business requirements into appropriate KPIs, metrics, data models, and reporting solutions.
* Engage with stakeholders throughout the development process to validate requirements and ensure the final solution addresses the underlying business need.
* Proactively challenge requirements where necessary and recommend alternative approaches that provide better scalability, usability, or long\-term value.
* Explain technical concepts, data limitations, and solution trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships with business teams and act as a trusted partner for analytics and reporting requirements.


 🔹 Collaboration \& Technical Leadership
   

  

* Work closely with data engineers, analysts, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver end\-to\-end analytics solutions.
* Participate in solution design discussions and provide guidance on Power BI, data modelling, DAX, and analytics architecture.
* Review existing development practices and recommend improvements to improve quality, consistency, and maintainability.
* Mentor junior Power BI developers and analysts through code reviews, knowledge sharing, pairing, and problem\-solving.
* Contribute to establishing development standards and best practices across Power BI and analytics initiatives.
* Stay current with developments in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and modern analytics practices and identify opportunities to apply them within projects.


**Skills Required**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing and delivering production\-grade Power BI solutions, including semantic models, reports, and deployment.
* Strong experience in Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.
* Advanced knowledge of DAX, with practical experience handling complex business calculations and optimising performance.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, dimensional modelling, and star\-schema design.
* Hands\-on experience with Power Query / M, including transformation, query folding, and incremental refresh.
* Strong SQL experience, particularly working with large datasets and complex queries.
* Hands\-on experience with PySpark and data transformation.
* Experience working with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, OneLake, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Direct Lake.
* Strong understanding of Power BI Service administration, workspaces, gateways, RLS, deployment pipelines, and refresh management.
* Experience identifying and resolving Power BI and data platform performance issues.
* Strong understanding of modern data warehousing and analytics concepts.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of analytics solutions from requirement gathering through production.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in simple business terms.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor junior developers or analysts and contribute to team\-wide development practices.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with a focus on delivering practical business outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* Experience working with Delta Lake, including schema evolution, time travel, optimisation, and partitioning strategies.
* Experience with Azure Data Factory or Microsoft Fabric Pipelines for data orchestration.
* Exposure to enterprise\-scale lakehouse and modern data platform environments.
* Experience working with large and complex datasets in a production analytics environment.
* Microsoft certifications such as PL\-300, DP\-600, or DP\-700 will be an advantage.

description:

 Detailed Description
   

  

* API Design and Development (Architecture \& Specs)


 Design \& Modelling: Design enterprise\-level RESTful and SOAP APIs using OpenAPI specifications (Swagger) and RAML, ensuring strict adherence to microservices architecture principles.
   

  

**Implementation:** 
 Build, configure, and publish complex APIs and loopback applications within the IBM API Connect ecosystem.
   

  

**Custom Policies:** 
 Develop advanced custom policies and gateways utilizing DataPower Extension routing, User\-Defined Policies (UDP), and custom JavaScript/GatewayScript.
   

  

* Integration \& Gateway Management (IBM DataPower)


**Gateway Configuration:** 
 Configure and maintain IBM DataPower Gateways (IDG) to handle traffic routing, throttling, message transformation (XSLT, JSON\-to\-XML), and payload validation.
   

  

**Backend Orchestration:** 
 Integrate APIs seamlessly with back\-end enterprise systems including Databases (SQL/NoSQL), and legacy SOAP web services.
   

  

* API Security \& Governance


**Security Enforcement:** 
 Implement robust API security policies including OAuth 2\.0, JWT, Mutual TLS (mTLS), SAML, and custom client authentication certificates.
   

  

**Governance \& Lifecycle:** 
 Manage the end\-to\-end API lifecycle (Drafting, Publishing, Deprecating, and Retiring) and enforce API product management principles, including rate limiting and monetization plans.
   

  

* DevOps, Deployment \& Operations


**CI/CD Automation:** 
 Build and optimize continuous integration and deployment pipelines for APIC artifacts using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, and APIC toolkits/CLI.
   

  

**Cloud Architecture:** 
 Deploy and manage APIC instances deployed on containerized environments (Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, Cloud Pak for Integration) or public cloud infra (AWS/Azure).
   

  

**Monitoring \& Analytics:** 
 Configure APIC Developer Portals and Analytics to monitor API performance, error tracking, usage metrics, and optimize payload caching.
   

  

 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
   

  

**Must\-Have Technical Skills**
**Primary Tooling:**
* Minimum 4\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on experience specifically working with IBM API Connect (including migrating or working with V10\) and IBM DataPower Gateways.
* Security Protocols: Mastery of API security standards (OAuth2, mTLS, SSL, WS\-Security).
* Coding \& Transformation: Proficient in GatewayScript, JavaScript, XSLT, XPath, and XML/JSON transformations.
* API Specs: High proficiency in writing clean OpenAPI 2\.0/3\.0 (YAML/JSON) specifications.
* Protocols: Deep understanding of REST, SOAP, HTTP/S, WebSockets, JMS.


**Nice\-to\-Have / Preferred Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with alternative API management tools (SAP PO, SAP CPI) for hybrid environments.
* Relevant IBM Certifications (e.g., IBM Certified Solution Developer \- API Connect).


**Soft Skill \& Leadership Requirements**
* Problem\-Solving: Proven ability to troubleshoot highly complex architectural, connectivity, and performance issues across distributed networks.
* Mentorship: Experience acting as a project Tech Lead, reviewing code for junior developers, and setting development standards.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical integration concepts to non\-technical stakeholders or product managers.


 Physical Demands
   

  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.


 Typical Experience
   

  

* 5 to 10 years; Experience in similar roles


 Typical Education
   

  

* Bachelor Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Educational Requirements may vary by Geography


 Notes
   

  

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
   

  

 Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).
   

  

 At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high\-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages.
   

  

 Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC):
   

  

**ATS:** 
 This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high\-reliability markets such as Industrial \& Smart Energy, Aerospace \& Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions.
   

  

**CCS:**

Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI\-driven growth.

Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. description:
Here at Appian, our values of
 **Intensity** 
 and

 define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. *Job Description:* 




 ABOUT THE TEAM
 



 Our Engineering team is revolutionizing how Appian resolves customer issues by building AI\-powered diagnostic tools and internal platforms that dramatically reduce resolution time. We combine deep technical expertise with AI innovation to empower support engineers to identify root causes faster, ensuring our customers experience uninterrupted business\-critical operations. This team operates with high autonomy and directly impacts customer satisfaction and retention across Appian's enterprise client base.
 



 THE OPPORTUNITY
 



 Appian is at an inflection point where intelligent automation meets customer success, and we need a technical leader who can architect and ship the next generation of diagnostic platforms. This role exists because our growing enterprise customer base demands faster, smarter issue resolution, and AI agents are the key to unlocking that scale. You will shape both the technical direction and the team culture while delivering tools that become essential to how Appian supports thousands of mission\-critical deployments worldwide.
 



 WHAT YOU'LL DO
 


* Lead the design and delivery of a scalable AI\-powered triage platform that reduces mean time to resolution by leveraging AI agents, LangChain frameworks, and intelligent diagnostics
* Lead the engineering team building AI\-powered diagnostic tools that cut customer issue resolution time in half while scaling a platform that empowers support engineers across the globe.
* Architect quarterly releases of diagnostic tools on AWS infrastructure, balancing innovation velocity with production stability and security requirements
* Build and grow a high\-performing engineering team through effective people management, technical mentorship, and career development focused on AI and cloud\-native technologies
* Partner with Customer Success and Product leadership to translate support pain points into engineering roadmaps that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction
* Drive technical excellence through hands\-on code reviews in Python and AI frameworks while establishing engineering best practices for the team
* Execute stakeholder management across engineering, product, and customer\-facing teams to align priorities and communicate progress on platform capabilities



 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
 


* Education: Hold a Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related STEM field
* Experience: 8\+ years of experience in software engineering with at least 2\+ years in engineering management or technical leadership roles
* AI Fluency: Proven fluency in AI and LLMs, encompassing both the strategic development of AI\-powered platform capabilities and the hands\-on application of AI tools to accelerate daily workflows
* Python Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python with demonstrated experience building production\-grade applications and diagnostic tools
* Cloud Infrastructure: Hands\-on experience designing and deploying scalable systems on AWS with knowledge of cloud\-native architectures

* People Leadership: Proven track record managing engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and technical mentorship

* Stakeholder Management: Strong communication skills with experience managing cross\-functional stakeholders and translating business needs into technical solutions



 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
 


* Customer Support Domain: Experience building tools or platforms for customer support, site reliability, or operations teams

* Enterprise SaaS: Experience working in enterprise software companies with complex multi\-tenant architectures
* Ecosystem Experience: We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise\-Grade Orchestration environment


     
 
  
 




**Tools and Resources** 




* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department\-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First\-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee\-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

title: Factory Data Architect - IT
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market\-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.
   

  

 To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a
 **Factory Information Architect \- IT in Chennai, India.**
 This role will lead the definition and governance of the
 **Factory Information Architecture for the Flex Future Factory ecosystem.** 
 The position will define how physical factory structures, logical business structures, and manufacturing information are represented, related, contextualized, and governed across manufacturing systems, analytics, Digital Twins, and AI\-enabled solutions.
   

  

 The role will work jointly with Factory Integration and Automation teams, which contribute technical naming, payload, connectivity, and implementation standards. The Factory Information Architect will ensure that the required enterprise capabilities, governance mechanisms, and technology solutions exist to catalog, manage, contextualize, validate, and monitor these standards at scale. The role must understand the relevant technologies sufficiently to define practical requirements and guide delivery teams, but is not expected to build pipelines or platforms directly.
   

  

 Reports to
 **Director** 
 and the role involves,
   

  

**What a typical day looks like:**
* Define and maintain the Future Factory Information Architecture strategy, standards, governance model, and roadmap.
* Define and govern the Physical Location Structure for factories, buildings, areas, production lines, cells, stations, equipment, and assets.
* Define and govern the Logical Factory Structure for business units, customers, programs, manufacturing entity or site codes, business units, customers and other core business entities.
* Establish common information models, identifiers, hierarchies, metadata, business definitions, and semantic relationships across physical and logical structures.
* Define requirements for data catalogs, business glossaries, metadata repositories, schema registries, and related capabilities needed to manage manufacturing information standards.
* Partner with Enterprise IT, Factory Integration and Automation teams on naming conventions, payload structures, attribute standards, data contracts, and controlled vocabularies, while ensuring enterprise alignment and governance.
* Define how manufacturing information must be mapped, transformed, validated, enriched, and contextualized as it moves across factory and enterprise platforms.
* Establish schema governance and validation requirements, including versioning, compatibility, mandatory attributes, quality rules, semantic conformance, exception handling, and monitoring.
* Govern Unified Namespace information structures, contextual models, ownership principles, and alignment with approved schemas and information standards.
* Define the information foundations required for Digital Twin, Knowledge Graph, analytics, and AI capabilities.
* Lead architecture reviews and governance forums, monitor adoption and conformance, and work with technical teams to ensure consistent implementation.


**The experience we’re looking to add to our team:**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience: Typically 10\+ years in information, data, enterprise, solution, or manufacturing systems architecture, including complex global or multi\-site initiatives.
* Strong experience with information modeling, metadata management, business and asset hierarchies, semantic standards, master and reference data, data catalogs, and governance frameworks.
* Experience defining schema governance, validation rules, data contracts, transformation requirements, information quality controls, and conformance processes.
* Good understanding of MES, ERP, SCADA, OT systems, equipment connectivity, quality, maintenance, inventory, engineering, and manufacturing operations.
* Working knowledge of MQTT, event streaming, APIs, integration services, ETL/ELT, schema registries, cloud data platforms, Knowledge Graphs, Digital Twins, and semantic technologies sufficient to evaluate options and guide implementation teams.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and decision\-making skills, with the ability to influence global cross\-functional teams.

title: vehicle diagnostics
description:
A typical
 **Vehicle Diagnostics Engineer** 
 role at
 **Renault Nissan Technology \& Business Centre India (RNTBCI)** 
 focuses on developing and validating vehicle diagnostic functions compliant with automotive standards.
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

**Vehicle Diagnostics Engineer**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and maintain vehicle diagnostic specifications for ECUs.
* Define and validate diagnostic functions based on UDS (ISO 14229\) and OBD\-II requirements.
* Configure and test Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), Diagnostic Identifiers (DIDs), and Routine Control services.
* Analyze CAN/LIN communication and troubleshoot diagnostic issues.
* Work with software, calibration, validation, and ECU suppliers to resolve diagnostic defects.
* Perform diagnostic validation using tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, or DDT2000\.
* Support software integration, vehicle testing, and issue analysis.
* Ensure compliance with Renault\-Nissan diagnostic standards and regulatory requirements.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, diagnostic specifications, and test reports.
* Participate in defect tracking and root cause analysis.


 Required Skills
   

  

* Knowledge of automotive communication protocols:
+ CAN
+ LIN
+ Ethernet (preferred)

* Understanding of:
+ UDS (ISO 14229\)
+ OBD\-II
+ ISO 15765 (CAN Transport Protocol)

* Experience with tools such as:
+ Vector CANoe
+ CANalyzer
+ DDT2000
+ INCA (preferred)

* Understanding of ECU architecture and embedded systems.
* Familiarity with diagnostics over CAN and vehicle networks.
* Basic scripting knowledge (CAPL or Python) is an advantage.
* Strong debugging and analytical skills.


 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Automobile, or related disciplines.
* Typically 2–6 years of experience in automotive diagnostics, ECU validation, or embedded systems.


 Common Interview Topics
   

  

* UDS services (0x10, 0x11, 0x19, 0x22, 0x27, 0x2E, 0x31, 0x34, 0x36, 0x37\).
* DTC lifecycle and fault memory.
* OBD\-II requirements and emission\-related diagnostics.
* CAN protocol, CAN frames, arbitration, and message IDs.
* Diagnostic session control and security access.
* Flash programming and bootloader concepts.
* CAPL scripting basics.
* ECU communication and diagnostic troubleshooting.
* Difference between functional and physical addressing.
* Positive and negative response codes in UDS.


 This role is suited to engineers with backgrounds in
 **automotive electronics, ECU diagnostics, embedded systems, or vehicle network validation** 
 , rather than mechanical design.

title: PLC Programmer
description:
**Company Description** 
 VEST Solutions (Versatile Engineering Systems \& Technology) provides engineering, automation, software, cloud, and digital solutions to clients worldwide. The company’s expertise spans steel detailing, LabVIEW development, PLC programming, and AI\-driven automation. VEST Solutions focuses on delivering customized, technology\-driven systems that improve efficiency and performance for industrial and commercial customers. Team members collaborate on multidisciplinary projects that integrate hardware, software, and advanced control systems.
 



**Role Description** 
 The PLC Programmer will design, develop, test, and maintain PLC\-based control systems for industrial automation projects. Responsibilities include creating and modifying PLC logic, configuring I/O and communication networks, and integrating PLCs with SCADA, HMI, and other control platforms. The role involves troubleshooting and resolving control system issues, performing on\-site commissioning, and ensuring that solutions meet performance, safety, and regulatory requirements. The PLC Programmer will collaborate closely with engineering, project management, and client teams to gather requirements, prepare documentation, and provide technical support throughout the project lifecycle. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Chennai.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong PLC programming skills in platforms such as Siemens, Allen\-Bradley, Schneider, or similar, including ladder logic and function block programming.
* Experience with industrial automation systems, including control panels, sensors, actuators, VFDs, and integration with SCADA/HMI interfaces.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, P\&IDs, and engineering drawings, with solid troubleshooting and diagnostic abilities.
* Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP) and networking basics for control systems.
* Understanding of safety standards and best practices in automation (e.g., interlocks, emergency stops, safety PLC concepts).
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or related engineering discipline.
* Effective communication and documentation skills, with the ability to collaborate in multidisciplinary teams and interact directly with clients.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Chennai and occasionally travel to customer locations for commissioning and support.
* Experience with LabVIEW, AI\-based automation, or cloud\-connected industrial solutions is an advantage.

title: Lead Cyber Security
description:
As a Senior Application \& Cloud Security Engineer (IC3\), you will take end\-to\-end technical ownership of our application security posture across Web, Mobile (iOS/Android), and Cloud (AWS) environments. You will be responsible for threat modeling, conducting deep\-dive vulnerability assessments (VAPT), embedding automated security gates into CI/CD pipelines, engineering advanced AWS WAF custom rules \& perimeter defenses, and leveraging Observability/SIEM platforms for proactive threat detection and incident monitoring.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities \& Core Scope** 



* **Web \& Mobile Application Security (AppSec)**
* **Web Application Security: Conduct comprehensive manual and automated vulnerability assessments (VAPT) across web platforms and microservice APIs based on OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10\.**
* **Mobile Application Security (iOS \& Android): Perform static and dynamic security assessments aligned with OWASP Mobile Application Security (MASVS) — auditing secure data storage, certificate pinning, biometric authentication, deep linking, reverse\-engineering resistance, and third\-party SDK security.**
* **Secure SDLC \& DevSecOps Automation: Integrate, tune, and scale SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Checkmarx, Veracode, Snyk, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite) inside GitHub Actions / GitLab CI pipelines with minimal developer friction.**
* **Threat Modeling: Lead collaborative threat modeling sessions (STRIDE / MITRE ATT\&CK) with developers and architects during sprint planning and architectural design phases.**
* **Vulnerability Remediation: Work directly with product engineering teams to provide code\-level remediation guidance, root\-cause analysis, and verification testing.**
* **AWS Security Hardening: Architect and maintain hardened AWS multi\-account structures (AWS Organizations, Control Tower, SCPs) aligned with CIS AWS Foundations Benchmarks.**
* **IAM \& Secrets Management: Design least\-privilege IAM policies, role\-based access controls, automated credential rotation, and secure key management via AWS KMS and Secrets Manager.**
* **Container \& Kubernetes Security: Enforce runtime protection, image scanning, and network policies for Docker containers and Kubernetes (EKS/ECS) workloads.**
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Security: Automate Terraform security auditing using tools such as Checkov, tfsec, and Trivy before deployments hit production.**
* **Perimeter Defense \& WAF Customization**
* **AWS WAF Engineering: Architect, deploy, and fine\-tune AWS WAF and Amazon CloudFront security configurations across all edge endpoints.**
* **Custom Rule Development: Write custom regex rules, rate\-limiting policies, IP set filtering, and bot control rules to mitigate Layer 7 DDoS, credential stuffing, scraping, and zero\-day vulnerabilities.**
* **Security Observability Platforms: Monitor security telemetry across platforms such as Elastic/OpenSearch, AWS CloudWatch, or Coralogix.**
* **Threat Detection \& Alerting: Aggregate and correlate security logs (VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, ALB logs, WAF logs, GuardDuty findings) to build high\-fidelity detection rules and actionable alert dashboards.**
* **Incident Response Support: Assist in triaging security events, performing log forensics, and automating alert escalations to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR).**
* **Compliance Alignment: Provide technical evidence and enforce controls for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and CIS Benchmarks.**
* **Tooling \& Cost Efficiency: Optimize security tool utilization, eliminate redundancy, and identify cloud architecture cost savings.**



**Mandatory Qualifications (Must\-Haves):** 



* Experience: 6–9 years in Application Security, Cloud Security, and DevSecOps.
* AppSec Mastery: In\-depth knowledge of Web \& Mobile (Android/iOS) security testing, API penetration testing, and secure code review.
* AWS Cloud Security: Hands\-on experience securing AWS services (IAM, VPC, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, S3, EKS/ECS).
* WAF \& Edge Defense: Proven experience configuring AWS WAF / CloudFront, including authoring custom WAF rules, rate limiting, and bot protection.
* Observability Experience: Practical experience querying and setting up alerts in modern observability/SIEM tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, ELK, CloudWatch, Sumo Logic).
* CI/CD Integration: Experience automating SAST/DAST/SCA scanners inside CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins).
* Threat Modeling: Solid track record using STRIDE and MITRE ATT\&CK frameworks for architecture reviews.



**Bonus / Good\-to\-Have (Optional):** 



* Certifications: Relevant offensive/security certifications: OSCP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, eWPTX, CEH, or CISSP.
* Emerging Tech: Experience or research in AI/LLM Security (OWASP LLM Top 10, Prompt Injection defense, RAG security).
* Prior experience managing, administering, or launching a Responsible Disclosure Program (VDP) or Bug Bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd, or internal security policy) is a strong added advantage.

title: Senior Java Developer - Vice President
description:
The Opportunity: Are You Ready to Build the Future of Risk Analytics?
   

  

 Want to solve one of the most challenging big data problems in finance today? Are you excited by the idea of working directly with front\-office and risk quants on massive\-scale analytics for critical regulations like FRTB? Do you want to tame billions of rows of complex financial data with Apache Spark and deliver insights to senior leaders in a fraction of a second?
   

  

 Citi is looking for an elite, hands\-on technologist to engineer the next\-generation analytics platform for our Market Risk organization. This isn't just another data job. You will be the architect and builder of a high\-performance system that ingests, processes, and serves petabytes of risk calculation data, making it instantly accessible and understandable to the entire firm.
   

  

 Your Role and Impact
   

  

 As a Senior Technologist, you will be at the heart of the action, designing the systems that power our most sophisticated risk\-based calculations. You will take the raw, trade\-level Present Value (PV) outputs from our Historical VaR and FRTB Expected Shortfall engines and transform them into a strategic data asset.
   

  

 Your impact will be immediate and far\-reaching. You will build the data pipelines that handle immense volumes, create intelligent APIs that democratize data access, and leverage cutting\-edge OLAP and NLP technologies to provide unparalleled drill\-down and analytical capabilities. You will be the go\-to expert who empowers senior stakeholders in the Markets and Risk organizations to make faster, smarter decisions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Architect and build robust, scalable data pipelines to ingest and process billions of trade\-level PV calculations from various stress engines.
* Develop and optimize large\-scale aggregation jobs using Apache Spark, ensuring high performance and efficiency.
* Design and deliver a suite of "intelligent data APIs" that provide flexible, on\-demand access to both aggregated and non\-aggregated risk data for teams across the firm.
* Integrate Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities to create intuitive, query\-based interfaces for data exploration, lowering the barrier to entry for complex analytics.
* Load and model massive aggregated datasets into high\-performance OLAP engines like Apache Pinot, Apache Druid, and Trino.
* Build powerful, interactive analytical tools and dashboards on top of the OLAP layer, providing summary views and lightning\-fast drill\-down capabilities.
* Partner directly with senior stakeholders in the Front Office, Quantitative teams, and Risk Management to understand their analytical needs and deliver innovative solutions.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience with Strong programming skills in Python, Java and/or Scala, and expert\-level SQL.
* A true passion for data, analytics, and solving complex problems at massive scale.
* A degree in a quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Financial Mathematics, or Financial Engineering.
* Expert\-level, hands\-on experience with big data technologies, particularly Apache Spark.
* Proven experience with high\-performance OLAP databases such as Apache Pinot, Apache Druid, or Trino.
* Strong background in fundamental computer science concepts, including data structures and algorithms.
* A mindset for 'AI\-first' development, constantly looking for ways to embed intelligence into systems.
* Experience or a strong interest in applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) to data access and analytics.
* A knack for solving 'needle in a haystack' problems, with a talent for debugging complex data and access issues.
* Experience in the financial industry with an understanding of market risk, derivatives, and risk calculations (VaR, Stress Testing, PV) is highly desirable.
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently and lead technical projects.
* Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to collaborate with senior business and quantitative stakeholders.
