title: Senior Software Engineer - Salesforce
description:
**Senior Software Engineer\-II Salesforce**
**About our Team:\-**
 Digital Business Solutions (DBS) delivers innovation and solves customer and business problems by leveraging the power of technology, data, and — increasingly — AI. Within DBS, the AI Innovation team focuses specifically on identifying and delivering agentic and generative AI capabilities across our Salesforce ecosystem and adjacent platforms. We partner with sales teams to drive intelligent automation, frictionless personalized experiences, and streamlined processes that support cost optimization and growth. We provide the expertise to understand business challenges and translate them into practical, responsible AI\-enabled solutions.
   

  

**About the Role:\-**
 This position performs complex research, design, and software development assignments within our Salesforce platform ecosystem (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud and adjacent integrated platforms), and provides direct input to project plans, schedules, and methodology in the development of cross\-functional solutions serving 2,000\+ users. This position performs software design across Salesforce org and integrated systems (e.g. Gainsight, Monday.com, Incentive Comp Platforms); mentors more\-junior members of the team; leverages AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and improve code quality; and talks to business users/stakeholders to translate their requests into scalable, compliant Salesforce solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities:\-**
* Interface with business analysts, platform admins, and other technical team members to finalize requirements across the Salesforce platform and its integrated ecosystem
* Write and review detailed technical specifications for complex system components, including custom Apex/LWC solutions and AI agent/automation designs
* Complete complex bug fixes across Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow automation, and third\-party integrations
* Work closely with other development team members to understand complex product requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce architecture and software designs
* Successfully implement development processes, coding best practices, code reviews, and AI\-assisted development standards (including responsible use, review, and validation of AI\-generated code)
* Design, build, and govern AI\-driven agents and automations on the platform (e.g., Agentforce), ensuring outputs are accurate, secure, and aligned with business processes
* Operate in various development environments (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) while collaborating with key stakeholders across sales technology teams
* Resolve complex technical issues across Salesforce and adjacent platforms (Oracle Sales Cloud Incentive Comp, Gainsight, Monday.com) as necessary
* Train and onboard entry\-level software engineers, ensuring they are knowledgeable in Salesforce development standards and AI\-assisted tooling as directed by department management
* Keep abreast of new Salesforce platform releases, AI feature developments, and evolving AI development tooling
* Design and work with complex Salesforce data models supporting a 2,000\+ user org, including performance and scalability considerations
* Mentor less\-senior software developers on Salesforce development methodologies, optimization techniques, and effective/responsible use of AI development tools
* Ensure development work aligns with release management, packaging, and compliance/audit requirements
* All other duties as assigned
* 5\+ years of Software Engineering experience, with 3\+ years building and supporting enterprise Salesforce implementations
* BS Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience required
* Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required; Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or System Architect certification strongly preferred
* Experience with regulated, audited, or compliance\-driven release environments a plus


**Requirements:\-**
* Advanced knowledge of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum, Waterfall) as applied to Salesforce release cycles and org governance
* Strong proficiency in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and data manipulation/optimization techniques (bulkification, governor\-limit\-aware design, asynchronous processing patterns)
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling: standard/custom objects, normalized vs. denormalized structures, sharing/security models, and large data volume (LDV) design
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce data storage and integration subsystems (Salesforce Connect, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, MuleSoft or equivalent middleware, external objects)
* Expertise in Salesforce development languages and frameworks: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura, JavaScript, SOQL/SOSL, Flow/Flow Orchestrator, and integration via REST/SOAP APIs; working knowledge of Java/J2EE, HTML, XML, SQL, and .NET for integration and legacy system touchpoints
* Hands\-on proficiency with AI\-assisted development tooling, including:
+ Agentforce and Salesforce's native AI capabilities (Einstein Copilot/Agentforce agents, prompt builder, model builder) to design and deploy AI\-driven workflows for business users
+ AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Code Genie/Agentforce for Developers, Cursor) to accelerate Apex/LWC development, generate test coverage, and support code review
+ Prompt engineering practices for building reliable, governed AI agents on the platform, including grounding, guardrails, and evaluation of AI\-generated outputs before production deployment
+ Evaluating AI\-generated code and configuration for security, governor\-limit compliance, and adherence to org coding standards prior to merge

* Strong research skills, including staying current on Salesforce release notes (three major releases/year) and AI feature rollouts
* Strong knowledge of industry best practices in Salesforce development (Apex design patterns, trigger frameworks, CI/CD via tools like Copado, Gearset, or Salesforce DX/SFDX pipelines)
* Knowledge of the broader sales technology tool stack and how it integrates with Salesforce (CPQ/Incentive Comp platforms, Customer Success platforms like Gainsight, work management tools like Monday.com)
* Ability to interface competently with business analysts, admins, and other technical personnel to finalize requirements and translate them into technical designs
* Ability to work well with internal teams and external SI/ISV partners
* Knowledge of test\-driven development, including Apex unit testing, LWC Jest testing, and AI\-assisted test generation
* Ability to write and review detailed technical specifications for complex system components, including AI agent/automation design documents
* Ability to complete complex bug fixes across Apex, LWC, integrations, and declarative automation (Flow)
* Good oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain AI\-assisted design decisions and tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long\-term goals.
   

  

 Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
   

  

**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Group Health Insurance Policy (covering self and family)
* Group Life insurance/accident policy
* Generous long\-service awards
* New Baby gift
* Subsidized food provided (applies to India \- Chennai)
* Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, Gazetted Public Holiday and Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Free Transport provided to and from the office (applies to India \- Chennai)


**About Us**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world

description:
**Senior Software Engineer\-II Salesforce**
**About our Team:\-**
 Digital Business Solutions (DBS) delivers innovation and solves customer and business problems by leveraging the power of technology, data, and — increasingly — AI. Within DBS, the AI Innovation team focuses specifically on identifying and delivering agentic and generative AI capabilities across our Salesforce ecosystem and adjacent platforms. We partner with sales teams to drive intelligent automation, frictionless personalized experiences, and streamlined processes that support cost optimization and growth. We provide the expertise to understand business challenges and translate them into practical, responsible AI\-enabled solutions.
   

  

**About the Role:\-**
 This position performs complex research, design, and software development assignments within our Salesforce platform ecosystem (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud and adjacent integrated platforms), and provides direct input to project plans, schedules, and methodology in the development of cross\-functional solutions serving 2,000\+ users. This position performs software design across Salesforce org and integrated systems (e.g. Gainsight, Monday.com, Incentive Comp Platforms); mentors more\-junior members of the team; leverages AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and improve code quality; and talks to business users/stakeholders to translate their requests into scalable, compliant Salesforce solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities:\-**
* Interface with business analysts, platform admins, and other technical team members to finalize requirements across the Salesforce platform and its integrated ecosystem
* Write and review detailed technical specifications for complex system components, including custom Apex/LWC solutions and AI agent/automation designs
* Complete complex bug fixes across Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow automation, and third\-party integrations

* Train and onboard entry\-level software engineers, ensuring they are knowledgeable in Salesforce development standards and AI\-assisted tooling as directed by department management
* Keep abreast of new Salesforce platform releases, AI feature developments, and evolving AI development tooling
* Design and work with complex Salesforce data models supporting a 2,000\+ user org, including performance and scalability considerations
* Mentor less\-senior software developers on Salesforce development methodologies, optimization techniques, and effective/responsible use of AI development tools
* Ensure development work aligns with release management, packaging, and compliance/audit requirements
* All other duties as assigned
* 5\+ years of Software Engineering experience, with 3\+ years building and supporting enterprise Salesforce implementations
* BS Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience required
* Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required; Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or System Architect certification strongly preferred
* Experience with regulated, audited, or compliance\-driven release environments a plus


**Requirements:\-**
* Advanced knowledge of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum, Waterfall) as applied to Salesforce release cycles and org governance
* Strong proficiency in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and data manipulation/optimization techniques (bulkification, governor\-limit\-aware design, asynchronous processing patterns)
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling: standard/custom objects, normalized vs. denormalized structures, sharing/security models, and large data volume (LDV) design
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce data storage and integration subsystems (Salesforce Connect, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, MuleSoft or equivalent middleware, external objects)
* Expertise in Salesforce development languages and frameworks: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura, JavaScript, SOQL/SOSL, Flow/Flow Orchestrator, and integration via REST/SOAP APIs; working knowledge of Java/J2EE, HTML, XML, SQL, and .NET for integration and legacy system touchpoints
* Hands\-on proficiency with AI\-assisted development tooling, including:
+ Agentforce and Salesforce's native AI capabilities (Einstein Copilot/Agentforce agents, prompt builder, model builder) to design and deploy AI\-driven workflows for business users
+ AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Code Genie/Agentforce for Developers, Cursor) to accelerate Apex/LWC development, generate test coverage, and support code review
+ Prompt engineering practices for building reliable, governed AI agents on the platform, including grounding, guardrails, and evaluation of AI\-generated outputs before production deployment
+ Evaluating AI\-generated code and configuration for security, governor\-limit compliance, and adherence to org coding standards prior to merge

* Strong research skills, including staying current on Salesforce release notes (three major releases/year) and AI feature rollouts
* Strong knowledge of industry best practices in Salesforce development (Apex design patterns, trigger frameworks, CI/CD via tools like Copado, Gearset, or Salesforce DX/SFDX pipelines)
* Knowledge of the broader sales technology tool stack and how it integrates with Salesforce (CPQ/Incentive Comp platforms, Customer Success platforms like Gainsight, work management tools like Monday.com)
* Ability to interface competently with business analysts, admins, and other technical personnel to finalize requirements and translate them into technical designs
* Ability to work well with internal teams and external SI/ISV partners
* Knowledge of test\-driven development, including Apex unit testing, LWC Jest testing, and AI\-assisted test generation
* Ability to write and review detailed technical specifications for complex system components, including AI agent/automation design documents
* Ability to complete complex bug fixes across Apex, LWC, integrations, and declarative automation (Flow)
* Good oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain AI\-assisted design decisions and tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long\-term goals.
   

  

 Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
   

  

**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Group Health Insurance Policy (covering self and family)
* Group Life insurance/accident policy

 Job Description: Junior ERP Functional Consultant (2\-4 Years Experience)
   

  

 This job description is for a junior\-to\-mid\-level Functional Consultant focused on Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems. The ideal candidate will combine functional business process knowledge with technical proficiency in SQL, Stored Procedures, and Cloud fundamentals to support system implementations and optimizations.
   

  

**Summary**
 We are seeking a motivated ERP Functional Consultant with 2 to 4 years of experience to join our Support / Implementation team. This role serves as a vital link between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that ERP solutions are configured to meet operational requirements while leveraging modern cloud environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Functional \& Consulting
   

  

* Requirement Gathering: Interface with business users to document current (AS\-IS) and future\-state (TO\-BE) workflows within the ERP ecosystem.
* System Configuration: Execute functional setups and configurations within ERP modules based on validated business requirements.
* Gap Analysis: Identify discrepancies between standard ERP functionality and business needs, recommending solutions that prioritize standard features over heavy customization.
* Testing \& Quality Assurance: Create and perform Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system behavior.
* Documentation: Maintain essential project artifacts, including functional design specifications and configuration workbooks.


 Technical \& Cloud Integration
   

  

* Database Operations (SQL): Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract data, troubleshoot application errors, and validate backend configurations.
* Logic Development: Utilize Stored Procedures and basic PL/SQL logic to support data transformations, custom validations, and interface development.
* Cloud Maintenance: Apply Cloud Basics to navigate cloud consoles, manage environment settings, and understand the architecture of SaaS/PaaS ERP deployments.
* Data Migration: Assist in the extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of legacy data into the ERP system, ensuring high levels of data integrity.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Experience: 2 to 4 years of professional experience in ERP functional consulting, support, or implementation.
* ERP Domain Knowledge: Proven functional understanding of core business processes such as Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), or SCM in any major ERP (e.g., Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics).
* Database Proficiency:


 ○ Advanced SQL skills, including the use of joins, subqueries, and analytical functions.
   

  

 ○ Hands\-on experience developing and troubleshooting Stored Procedures.
   

  

* Cloud Literacy: Fundamental understanding of cloud computing concepts (e.g., identity management, environments/instances, and cloud storage).
* Tools: Familiarity with database management tools like SQL Developer, Toad, or similar IDEs.
* Soft Skills: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical business users.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Functional experience with any ERP.
* Technical proficiency in SQL and Stored procedures.
* Certification in a specific ERP cloud module or Cloud Infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, or OCI).

description:

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Energy Systems**
 We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production\-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital \& Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.
   

  

 This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification \& Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.
   

  

 This is not a project\-based delivery or staff\-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.
   

  

 Working in close partnership with Frontend Engineers, Product leadership, Data \& AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security \& Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI\-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.
   

  

 The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft\-oriented full\-stack environment. The primary stack includes C\# and .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Docker, .NET Aspire, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams.
   

  

 This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low\-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform.
   

  

 \*\*This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role\-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.\*\*
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Engineering \& Delivery**
* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable application and platform capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
* Build cohesive product experiences across backend services, APIs and platform integrations.

* Own product capabilities through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and iterative improvement rather than treating delivery as complete when the initial feature is released.
* NET Application Development
* Develop modern API capabilities using C\#, .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, and related technologies.
* Develop solutions for Azure and contribute to their deployment and support.
* Support application modernization efforts, including refactoring, technical debt reduction, framework upgrades, and migration from legacy patterns where appropriate.
* Develop application capabilities used for structured review workflows, real\-time collaboration, issue tracking, customer interaction, reporting, and delivery of technical work products.
* Partner with Product and design stakeholders to ensure application functionality is intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user workflows.
* Develop APIs, backend services, frontend components, and integration patterns that support platform interoperability.
* Help integrate applications with data services, AI\-enabled capabilities, workflow configurations, authentication patterns, and enterprise systems.
* Contribute to reusable development patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve team velocity and consistency.
* Integrate data\-driven, search, agentic, and AI\-enabled capabilities into production web applications using well\-defined APIs and reusable application patterns.


**Modern Development \& AI\-Enabled Engineering**
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis.
* Apply strong engineering judgment when using LLM\-enabled workflows, ensuring generated or assisted code meets standards for quality, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Use AI\-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity.


**DevOps, Reliability \& Security**
* Contribute to Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, monitoring, and incident readiness.
* Build software using an Agile methodology, with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support.
* Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations.
* Collaborate with Platform Reliability, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to support secure, reliable, and maintainable production systems.


**Collaboration \& Technical Ownership**
* Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Data \& AI Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, Security, and regional teams in a globally distributed environment.
* Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support.
* Communicate technical trade\-offs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, pairing, and shared engineering practices.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
* Contribute actively within planning and design meetings, speaking up where potential issues arise or where a requirement is poorly defined.
* Champion potential solutions to problems and communicate them clearly to the team.


 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 \*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
   

  

 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience developing production software in application engineering, software engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles.
* Strong production experience developing backend applications and services using C\# and modern .NET.
* Experience designing REST APIs and building distributed or service\-oriented application capabilities.
* Deep understanding of SQL and database optimisation.
* Experience building, modernizing, or operating scalable web applications in production environments, especially applications that support complex workflows, collaboration, reporting, document review, or customer\-facing delivery.
* Experience building APIs, backend services, frontend components, integrations, and application capabilities in production environments.
* Experience developing, deploying, and supporting cloud\-hosted applications, with practical experience in Microsoft Azure strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of software design, testing, code quality, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, source control, code review, and modern software delivery practices.
* Demonstrated experience using AI\-assisted development tools or LLM\-enabled coding workflows to improve development productivity.
* Ability to collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Reliability, and cross\-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams.


**What Is Preferred**
* Experience in Search, RAG or AI integration technologies.
* Experience of real\-time collaboration or data syncing with technologies such as SignalR or WebSockets.
* Experience in frontend systems such as React or Blazor.
* Experience in product\-led or platform\-based organizations.
* Familiarity with low\-code or hybrid development environments.
* Experience with collaborative due diligence, document review, workflow, reporting, Q\&A, risk management, or transaction delivery applications.
* Experience supporting interoperability across multiple systems or enterprise platforms.
* Experience working in a broader multi\-cloud enterprise environment, including familiarity with AWS.
* Background in energy, infrastructure, renewables, assurance, certification, or other technically complex industries.
* Experience with multi\-cloud environments spanning Azure and AWS.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications or integrating acquired software products into a broader enterprise platform.

title: Network Systems Developer
description:
As a Network Monitoring \& Observability Engineer, you will be responsible for administering network monitoring platforms, defining monitoring standards, and automating observability solutions. You will support both current and future monitoring technologies while ensuring operational reliability and meaningful visibility into network performance, availability, and health.
   

  

 This role requires a strong understanding of network monitoring principles, enterprise networking, Linux administration, and Python\-based automation.
   

  

 Network Management System Administration
   

  

* Administer enterprise monitoring platforms such as SevOne, Netcool, ThousandEyes, ScienceLogic, Selector.ai, LogicMonitor, and Prometheus.
* Manage platform installations, upgrades, patching, maintenance, and lifecycle activities.
* Monitor system health, capacity, and platform performance.


 Monitoring Strategy \& Standards
   

  

* Design and maintain monitoring standards and templates.
* Define key performance indicators and alerting thresholds for routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and other network infrastructure.
* Implement baselining and anomaly detection strategies.


 Linux Platform Administration
   

  

* Manage Linux servers supporting monitoring platforms.
* Maintain operating systems, file systems, databases, security configurations, and scheduled jobs.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure issues impacting monitoring services.


 Automation \& Integration
   

  

* Develop Python scripts to automate device onboarding, reporting, and platform integrations.
* Integrate monitoring platforms using REST APIs and automation workflows.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation and self\-service capabilities.


 Configuration \& Version Management
   

  

* Use Git for version control of scripts, configuration files, and automation artifacts.
* Maintain documentation and change history for production configurations.


 Data Collection \& Telemetry
   

  

* Configure and optimize Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP), Syslog, NetFlow, sFlow, IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX), and streaming telemetry.
* Ensure reliable collection, storage, and analysis of monitoring data.


**Required Qualifications**
 Network Monitoring \& Observability
   

  

* Strong understanding of network monitoring principles including polling intervals, retention policies, baselining, and anomaly detection.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Strong knowledge of SNMP, including MIBs, OIDs, notifications, and security models.
* Experience implementing traffic\-flow monitoring using NetFlow, sFlow, or IPFIX.


 Networking Fundamentals
   

  

* CCNA\-level understanding of TCP/IP networking concepts.
* Knowledge of latency, packet loss, jitter, routing, and subnetting.
* Understanding of routing protocols and network health indicators, including BGP and OSPF.
* Ability to troubleshoot connectivity issues involving firewalls, ACLs, and routing.


 Linux Administration
   

  

* Experience administering Linux systems such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux, CentOS, or Ubuntu.
* Familiarity with log analysis, system performance troubleshooting, and database fundamentals.


 Automation \& Development
   

  

* Proficiency in Python scripting.
* Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs.
* Experience using Git and modern version\-control workflows.
* Preferred Qualifications
+ Experience migrating between network monitoring or observability platforms.
+ Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or similar observability solutions.
+ Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
+ Experience with time\-series databases and telemetry architectures.
+ Exposure to cloud\-based network monitoring solutions.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
AssetPlus is redefining the future of wealth management. We're a fast\-scaling SaaS fintech platform powering mutual fund distributors (MFDs) and financial advisors with tools that modernise how investments are managed. Our mission is to build India's best assisted wealth management platform, helping millions of households achieve their financial goals.
 



  





 Engineering at AssetPlus is a growth led, high\-velocity team of \~18 engineers organized into three product pods. We ship on a modern, AI\-enabled Node.js \+ TypeScript \+ MongoDB stack, own our systems in production, and hold a high technical and cultural bar. If you want to solve meaningful problems at scale with real ownership, this is the place.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for a deeply hands\-on SDE\-3 who owns features end\-to\-end and raises the quality bar within a pod. You bring strong technical judgment, speed, clarity and simplicity to everything you build. You will be a core builder inside one product pod: designing services, writing production Node.js \+ TypeScript, shaping MongoDB schemas, debugging across backend, React and Flutter, and keeping the systems you own reliable. You will use AI as a cognitive partner to move faster without lowering the bar.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Architecture \& Systems** 



* Design and build scalable, resilient services within your pod's domain.
* Contribute to system design reviews and argue trade\-offs with first\-principles reasoning.
* Decide what to build vs reuse vs adopt open\-source, and explain the call.
* Follow and strengthen the architecture patterns the team has agreed on.



**Hands\-On Engineering** 



* Write high\-quality Node.js \+ TypeScript code \- readable, tested, production\-grade.
* Design efficient MongoDB schemas and build complex aggregations.
* Debug issues across React, Flutter and Backend, down to the infra and DB layer.
* Leverage AI capabilities and develop at a high pace with good taste.



**AI Driven Engineering** 



* Use AI as a cognitive partner to accelerate coding, debugging, design and decision\-making.
* Orchestrate models, tools, context and workflows into a productive AI\-powered engineering loop.
* Continuously adopt new AI capabilities to compound speed and improve system quality.
* Bring AI native practices into your pod's day\-to\-day workflow.



**Reliability \& Support** 



* Monitor the systems you own and catch issues early.
* Respond to critical incidents with urgency \- including off\-hours when it matters.
* Drive root\-cause analysis, performance improvements and observability.



**Developer Experience \& Quality** 



* Contribute to improving developer workflows, tooling and automation.
* Maintain high standards around clarity, testing, security and simplicity.
* Advocate for minimal, robust and maintainable engineering.



**Leadership \& Collaboration** 



* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers and review their work closely.
* Communicate decisions clearly and confidently.
* Be approachable, energetic and easy to build with.



  





**What we are looking for;** 




 Must have
 


* 6–8 years of full stack experience with a backend\-heavy core (experience range is indicative \- we hire for ownership, not tenure)
* Strong Node.js \+ TypeScript in production; you have owned services end\-to\-end, not just contributed
* Solid MongoDB \- schema design, indexing, complex aggregations
* Built and operated systems under real load; comfortable being on the hook when they break
* Strong debugging across backend, frontend and DB layer
* Pragmatic engineering judgment \- simple \> clever; sound build vs reuse vs open\-source calls
* Strong communicator \- can clearly explain a system you owned and the decisions behind it



 Strongly Preferred
 


* Hands\-on AWS \- CloudWatch, ECS, Amplify, Lambda, SQS, SES
* React and/or Flutter exposure \- enough to debug across the stack
* Fintech, wealth\-tech or SEBI\-regulated product experience
* Daily use of AI coding tools as a real productivity multiplier, not a novelty
* Experience mentoring juniors and running meaningful code reviews
* CI/CD, Docker and GitHub\-based workflows in a fast\-shipping team

title: Senior T-SQL Developer
description:
**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **T\-SQL Developer** 
 to design and build database logic — ranging from simple lookups to complex, multi\-step processing — on
 **Microsoft SQL Server** 
 . This role has a strong emphasis on
 **Dynamic SQL** 
 , used to drive
 **configuration\-based execution** 
 , where business rules, parameters and processing paths are controlled through metadata/configuration tables rather than hard\-coded logic. The ideal candidate is comfortable building flexible, reusable and performant database components that adapt their behaviour at runtime based on configuration.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design and develop
 **database logic of varying complexity** 
 — from simple parameterized procedures to complex, multi\-branch processing logic
* Build and maintain
 **Dynamic SQL** 
 \-driven stored procedures that execute different logic paths based on configuration/metadata tables
* Design
 **configuration\-driven frameworks** 
 (metadata tables, control tables, parameter\-driven templates) that allow business rules to be modified without code changes
* Write and optimize complex
 **T\-SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, triggers and views**
* Ensure Dynamic SQL is built securely (e.g., using sp\_executesql with parameterization) to prevent SQL injection and support plan reuse
* Analyze and tune query performance, including execution plans for dynamically generated queries
* Design and maintain configuration/control tables that drive execution logic, filtering, joins or transformation rules
* Collaborate with business analysts and application teams to translate changing business rules into configuration\-driven logic rather than repeated code changes
* Develop robust error handling, logging and auditing for dynamically executed SQL
* Refactor static/hard\-coded logic into flexible, configuration\-driven Dynamic SQL solutions where appropriate
* Participate in code reviews, unit testing and documentation of Dynamic SQL logic and configuration schemas
* Troubleshoot and debug dynamically generated queries in production environments
* Ensure data integrity, security and compliance across all database objects



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 3\+ years of hands\-on
 **T\-SQL development** 
 experience on Microsoft SQL Server
* **Strong, demonstrable experience with Dynamic SQL** 
 , including sp\_executesql, parameterized dynamic queries and dynamic object/column resolution
* Strong expertise in stored procedures, functions, triggers, views and cursors
* Solid understanding of SQL injection risks and secure Dynamic SQL coding practices
* Experience with query performance tuning and execution plan analysis, including for dynamically built queries
* Ability to translate variable/changing business logic into generalized, reusable, parameter\-driven code
* Solid understanding of relational database design, normalization and data modelling
* Strong analytical and debugging skills, particularly for troubleshooting runtime\-generated SQL



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills** 



* Experience building rules engines or config\-driven ETL/processing frameworks in SQL Server
* Familiarity with SSIS for orchestrating configuration\-driven data workflows
* Experience with Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instance or AWS RDS for SQL Server
* Knowledge of PowerShell or scripting for automation around configuration deployment
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum development methodologies
* Experience with version control tools (Git, TFS/Azure DevOps)
* Familiarity with logging/auditing frameworks for dynamically executed code



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Good communication skills and ability to work with business and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, especially when validating dynamically constructed logic
* Ability to think in terms of reusable, generalized solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Comfortable working with ambiguous or evolving business rules and translating them into structured configuration
* Collaborative mindset for working with DBAs, developers and business teams

description:
Area(s) of responsibility
   

  

 Empowered By Innovation
   

  

 Birlasoft, a global leader at the forefront of Cloud, AI, and Digital technologies, seamlessly blends domain expertise with enterprise solutions. The company’s consultative and design\-thinking approach empowers societies worldwide, enhancing the efficiency and productivity of businesses. As part of the multibillion\-dollar diversified CKA Birla Group, Birlasoft with its 12,000\+ professionals, is committed to continuing the Group’s 170\-year heritage of building sustainable communities.
   

  

 Job Title / Position:
 **Informatica IDMC Lead**
 Experience: 8\-10 years
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad / Chennai / Mumbai
   

  

 Shift: 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**IDMC Development and Integration**
* Develop, configure, and maintain data integration mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and schedules using Informatica Cloud Data Integration (CDI).
* Build ETL and ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load data across cloud and on\-premises sources and targets.

* Good understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and integration design patterns.
* Experience with REST APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, CSV, and secure file\-transfer mechanisms. Exposure to Kafka or event streaming is a plus.


**Databases, Cloud, and Engineering Tools**
* Strong SQL skills and experience with at least two platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Databricks.
* Exposure to one or more cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.

 As the senior IC owner of the Seismic platform, this person will independently architect and maintain the full integration ecosystem connecting Seismic to CRM systems (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), data warehouses, and adjacent enablement tools, taking ownership from requirements gathering through technical design, build, testing, and production deployment. They will write, review, and maintain production\-grade integration code (Python, JavaScript, or similar), including API connectors, webhook handlers, and automated data pipelines, and will be expected to solve the hardest technical problems on the team personally rather than delegating them.
   

  

 This role carries responsibility for the technical roadmap of the Seismic platform, including evaluating new Seismic features and capabilities (LiveDocs, Seismic Meeting Intelligence, AI\-driven content tools) and making build\-vs\-buy and architecture recommendations to leadership. The senior SME will lead complex, cross\-functional integration projects end\-to\-end — such as CRM migrations, new data source onboarding, or platform version upgrades — serving as the primary technical decision\-maker while coordinating with stakeholders in IT, security, and compliance.
   

  

 The person in this role will also serve as the final escalation point for platform and integration issues that other teams cannot resolve, conducting deep root\-cause analysis on data sync failures, performance degradation, and API errors. They are expected to proactively identify technical debt, integration fragility, or scalability risks in the current architecture and bring forward solutions before they become critical issues. Mentoring less senior team members and reviewing their integration code or configurations may be expected, even though this is an IC role without formal direct reports. Finally, this person will own comprehensive technical documentation of the integration architecture, data flows, and disaster recovery procedures, ensuring institutional knowledge doesn't sit with a single individual.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience administering, configuring, and architecting Seismic implementations at an enterprise scale, including content management, workspaces, LiveDocs, permissions/governance, and analytics/reporting modules
* 4\+ years of demonstrated experience independently designing and building complex API\-based integrations (REST/SOAP, webhooks) between Seismic and enterprise Snowflake data platforms CRM, with the ability to own the full integration lifecycle without support from other engineers
* Expert\-level troubleshooting and debugging skills across the full integration stack — reading and interpreting logs, debugging API calls, diagnosing data sync/latency issues, and performing root\-cause analysis under time pressure
* Deep knowledge of authentication and security protocols (OAuth 2\.0, SAML/SSO) and experience managing API rate limits, token refresh logic, and secure credential handling
* Proven track record of leading technical projects independently from requirements through production deployment, including stakeholder management, without formal authority over other team members
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills, capable of producing architecture diagrams, runbooks, and specifications usable by both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously, making sound technical judgment calls and escalating strategically rather than reflexively


**Preferred Skills**
 Seismic certification(s) at an advanced level (e.g., Seismic Certified Administrator, Seismic Certified Developer if available)
   

  

* Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, insurance, healthcare) with associated compliance, recordkeeping, and content governance requirements
* Experience with data warehousing and BI tooling (Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI) to build custom reporting layers on top of Seismic usage and engagement data
* Experience leading large\-scale platform migrations, replatforming efforts, or M\&A\-driven system consolidations
* Prior experience in sales enablement, marketing operations, or revenue operations, providing business context that informs better technical decisions
* Experience acting as an informal technical mentor or "tech lead" on a team without formal management responsibility

title: Engr, Sys Des
description:
****Company Overview****
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.
   

  

****Job Description/Preferred Qualifications****
 Job Description/Preferred Qualifications
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Candidate should have Doctorate/Master's degree in either of Physics, Engineering Physics, Engineering Design, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Materials and Metallurgical Engineering.
   

  

 Knowledge in instrumentation, signal processing and optical/electro\-optical systems such as electron microscopes is preferred.
   

  

 Experience with Vacuum Systems, Electron Optics, and High Voltage for scanning electron microscopes or equivalent a plus.
   

  

 Hands\-on experiences in machine control and/or scientific data analysis is highly desired.
   

  

 Candidate must have demonstrated an ability in setting\-up experiments, modelling and data analysis, solving complex technical problems.
   

  

 Candidate must have demonstrated proficiency in scripting language (MATLAB, Python, others) for scientific data collection \& analysis.
   

  

 Finally, the candidate must have excellent communication, interpersonal skills and ability to create effective technical presentations.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Work within the engineering team on designing new or improving designs of existing electron\-beam imaging products for the semiconductor equipment market.
   

  

 The product subsystems include light optics, electron optics, imaging, detectors, HV electronics, vacuum systems, wafer transfer systems, detection and classification algorithms, machine control and UI software.
   

  

 The candidate is expected to gain a detailed functional understanding of the entire product, act independently, devise and drive innovative analyses and solutions for complex problems.
   

  

 Activities will include development of new designs by specifying SW / Algo / HW requirements followed by characterization, product integration and maintenance.
   

  

 Candidate is expected to be involved in on\-site customer support in Taiwan, Korea, Singapore, etc.
   

  

 For necessary training, candidate would be trained at our Singapore and US offices. The overall travel load is between 75\-90%

 Dual Degree with 2 years relevant experience or Doctorate
   

  

 (Mech, Electrical, Mechatronics, Engineering Design, Engineering Physics)

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced and proactive
 **Senior SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) Functional Consultant** 
 to serve as a subject matter expert in Direct Procurement within the automotive/manufacturing domain. This role will lead the end\-to\-end requisition\-to\-order (RTO) stream, translating complex manufacturing supply chain needs into robust, scalable SAP S/4HANA and Fiori configurations.
   

  

*The Senior SAP MM Functional Consultant will drive activities across the full implementation lifecycle:*
* Requirements Engineering \& Business Analysis: Lead discovery workshops, conduct Fit/Gap analyses between standard S/4HANA capabilities and Ford's Direct Procurement processes, and document user stories, Epics, and functional requirements.
* Functional Design \& Architecture: Author comprehensive Functional Design Documents (FDDs) for direct material procurement workflows, including Scheduling Agreements (LP/LPA), Purchase Orders, Directed Tier\-2 sourcing, Subcontracting, and Intercompany stock transfers.
* Technical Collaboration \& Build Oversight: Partner with technical software engineering teams (ABAP, SAP Fiori / UI5, Google Cloud Platform / PCF integration middleware) to translate functional requirements into high\-quality technical deliverables; review Technical Design Documents (TDDs) and code handoffs.
* Legacy Integration \& Ecosystem Interoperability: Design and validate integration points between SAP S/4HANA MM and Ford's legacy non\-SAP manufacturing, planning, bill of materials (BOM), and warehouse systems, as well as SAP Ariba (Sourcing \& Supply Chain Collaboration).
* End\-to\-End Testing \& Defect Resolution: Architect and execute test strategies covering Functional Unit Testing (FUT), System Integration Testing (SIT), Security/Authorization validation, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT); drive root\-cause analysis and defect triage.
* Data Migration \& Cutover Readiness: Support master data profiling, cleansing, field mapping, and validation for Direct Procurement data entities (Material Masters, Business Partners/Vendors, Info Records, Source Lists, Quota Arrangements). Assist in cutover simulation and go\-live deployment.
* Process Governance \& SME Roadmap: Act as Direct Procurement SME to define global template design standards for Ford's automotive manufacturing plants, mitigating localized custom code and ensuring alignment with Clean Core principles.
* Change Enablement \& Post Go\-Live Support: Develop end\-user training materials, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and deliver hypercare and steady\-state stabilization across global deployment waves.


**Technical \& Functional Competencies**
* Core SAP S/4HANA MM Expertise: Deep functional and configuration knowledge of Direct Material Requisitioning, Automated PO Generation, Scheduling Agreements with Release Documentation (FRC/JIT delivery schedules), Evaluated Receipt Settlement (ERS), Subcontracting, Consignment, and Intercompany STO.
* Automotive / Manufacturing Direct Procurement: Comprehensive grasp of automotive supply chain dynamics, plant\-floor logistics interfaces, JIT/JIS procurement, directed component tiers (Tier\-1 / Directed Tier\-2 flows), and plant inventory valuation.
* Integration Knowledge: Strong cross\-module integration understanding across SAP MM\-PP (MRP / Material Requirements Planning), MM\-SD/LE (Logistics Execution / Inbound Deliveries), MM\-FI/CO (Account Determination, GR/IR clearing, Product Costing), and MM\-QM (Quality Inspection / Goods Receipt).
* Modern SAP Ecosystem: Proficiency with SAP Fiori role\-based apps, SAP Ariba Strategic Sourcing \& Supply Chain Collaboration (SCC), B2B EDI communication (EDIFACT/ANSI X12 via IDocs, APIs, OData services), and SAP Activate agile delivery methodology.
* Total Professional Experience: 7 to 10 years of overall IT / enterprise application implementation experience.
* SAP Functional MM Experience: 5 to 7 years of hands\-on functional design, configuration, and testing experience in SAP MM.
* Full Lifecycle Implementations: Demonstrated participation in at least 1–2 full lifecycle implementations of SAP S/4HANA (Greenfield, Brownfield, or Central Finance/iERP deployment) including Fiori interface rollout.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mechanical/Industrial Engineering, Business Information Technology, or related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Leadership \& Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional global teams (IT, business stakeholders, system integrators), facilitate requirements workshops, and communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical leaders.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical, diagnostic, and root\-cause analysis mindset with meticulous attention to detail.

 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and

 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.

*

**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data
