title: Associate Architect
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
 At Presidio, we’re at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting\-edge digital solutions and next\-generation AI. We empower businesses—and their customers—to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
   

  

**The Role**
**Strategic Ownership \& Leadership**
* Own and manage the cloud ecosystem across AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring they operate with high efficiency, strong governance, and predictable costs.
* Lead a small team of cloud engineers, guiding and coaching them in roadmap creation, prioritization, execution, and skills development.
* Act as a strategic advisor to engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders on sandbox governance, usage patterns, and optimization strategies.
* Establish and enforce policies for onboarding, offboarding, resource lifecycle, and access management for users.


**Operational Excellence \& Automation**
* Design and implement automation for sandbox provisioning, quota management, access approval workflows, scheduling, and spin\-up/spin\-down processes.
* Develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Cloud\-native tools) for repeatable lab operations.\[MS1]
* Create self\-service capabilities and guardrails for sandbox users to reduce manual effort and improve governance.
* Collaborate on lab, demo, and proof of concept engagements with internal and external stakeholders.


**FinOps, Cost Governance \& Optimization**
* Implement a FinOps\-aligned operating model for all accounts including tagging standards, cost allocation, budget enforcement, and showback/chargeback across all clouds.
* Continuously analyze cloud spend trends, forecast usage, and proactively identify opportunities for rightsizing, decommissioning, and efficiency improvements.
* Build automation for policy\-based cleanup of unused/idle resources.


**Security, Governance \& Compliance**
* Define and implement security guardrails, baseline configurations, identity/access rules, and monitoring policies for sandbox environments.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance controls and enforce boundaries between sandbox and production environments.
* Implement monitoring dashboards, alerts, and operational metrics to ensure visibility and control.


**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively introduce new approaches, tools, and technologies to make lab and demo operations more efficient, secure, and cost\-effective.
* Conduct periodic reviews of account usage patterns to identify opportunities for consolidation, automation, or architectural improvements.
* Partner with cloud providers, vendors, and internal teams to evaluate new services and establish best practices.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or cloud operations roles, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or team lead position.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and working knowledge of the other two.
* Demonstrated experience in managing large or multi\-tenant cloud environments, including governance, account/projects/subscription management.
* Strong automation experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Understanding of Cloud Networking Concepts, such as AWS VPCs, Transit Gateways, Azure VNets, Public DNS with AWS Route 53 and VPN tunnel creation from the hyperscaler side.
* Familiarity with Cloud Compute and Storage such as EC2 Instances, Azure Virtual Machines, Google Compute Engine, AWS S3/EBS/EFS and/or Azure Disk Storage
* Proven expertise in FinOps, cloud cost governance, and optimization frameworks.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, guardrails, monitoring, and policy management.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications: AWS Solutions Architect / Azure Architect Expert / GCP Professional Cloud Architect.
* Prior experience in managing demo or lab environments, platform engineering, or multi\-cloud landing zones.
* Experience with cost analytics tools (CloudHealth, Flexera, Cloud Custodian, Kubecost, native cost tools).
* Knowledge of container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD workflows.
* Exposure to Cloud Centers of Excellence (CCoE) or platform engineering teams.


**Your future at Presidio**
 Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers—thinkers, builders, and collaborators—who push the boundaries of what’s possible. With our expertise in AI\-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next\-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data\-driven transformation, you’ll be part of a team that is shaping the future.
   

  

**Ready to innovate? Let’s redefine what’s next—together.**
**About Presidio**
 At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades\-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio’s expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, enables actionable data insights and builds forward\-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally.
 **For more information, visit www.presidio.com** 
**.**
 Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.
   

  

***Recruitment Agencies, Please Note:***
 Presidio does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email address, Presidio employees or any other means. Presidio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

title: Product Security and Privacy Architect
description:
****An Amazing Career Opportunity for Product Security and Privacy Architect**
**Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid)**
**Job ID: 47565****
**Profile Summary:**
 As part of the Product Security and Privacy team, reporting to the Chief Product Security \& Privacy Architect, you will support product teams in adopting and implementing HID’s security and privacy program.
   

  

 Accountable for the quality, consistency, and defensibility of all security \& privacy related artifacts you guarantee that outputs are “audit\-ready,” and not just “done.
   

  

 You will have opportunities to work on a very wide portfolio of applications based on different technologies (Web, Embedded, Mobile, Desktop) within a very diverse and international context covering all five HID Business Areas.
   

  

**About HID Global**
 HID Global powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things. We make it possible for people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. Our trusted identity solutions give people secure and convenient access to physical and digital places and connect things that can be accurately identified, verified and tracked digitally. Millions of people around the world use HID products and services to navigate their everyday lives, and over 2 billion things are connected through HID. We work with governments, educational institutions, hospitals, financial institutions, industrial businesses, and some of the most innovative companies on the planet. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, HID Global has over 4500 employees worldwide and operates international offices that support more than 100 countries. HID Global® is an ASSA ABLOY Group brand. HID Global has is the trusted source for secure identity solutions for millions of customers and users around the world. In India, we have two Engineering Centre (Bangalore and Chennai). Global Engineering Team is based in Chennai and one of the Business Unit Engineering team is based in Bangalore. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
   

  

 LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/
   

  

**Are You Ready to Join the Team?**
 Our company is committed to finding the best and the brightest talent to help us reach the top. If you are a dynamic, highly skilled, experienced Cloud engineer and technology enthusiast, and you enjoy working in a rapid pace within a rapidly growing business environment, then you will want to consider this position. If you excel at communication, collaboration, and unrelenting innovation, we want to talk to you. And if you bring dedication, positive energy and integrity to the table, you just might be the right fit for our team.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities (Other Duties May Be Assigned)**
* Leads day\-to\-day security/privacy architecture governance, escalates and obtains approval from the Chief Product Security \& Privacy Architect as required.
* Define corporate wide security and privacy requirements, controls, and standards.
* Define corporate wide Secure Coding, third\-party, deployment policies \& other architecture\-related standards.
* Define required training content.
* Define paved roads/security and privacy\-by\-design patterns and libraries.
* Lead development of AI\-enabled PSP Architecture capabilities: define use cases, requirements, and success criteria.
* Own the threat modeling framework and quality bars.
* Run/approve security \& privacy architecture reviews.
* Lead audit/assessment planning, evidence of expectations, and defensibility.
* Responsible for tooling selection and integration related to security \& privacy architecture domain.
* Architect for compliance, analyze new regulations and standards to identify gaps in the platform's capabilities, standards, and controls.
* Assess New Acquisitions Architecture and contribute to due diligence on a needed basis.


**Primary Duties:**
 These define the broader responsibilities and areas of ownership within the role
   

  

* Provide recommendations for risk acceptance and exception requests.
* Provide input on tooling strategy and integration guidance for non\-architecture related domains.
* Provide guidance on security requirements for supply chain tooling, pipeline architecture, and associated standards.
* Validate that platform architecture enables enforcement of PSP security controls.
* Provide expert input on exploitability, attack paths, and mitigation options during Incident handling process
* Provide guidance on true risk vs noise for security tool outputs and penetration tests.
* Provide subject\-matter depth during training delivery: advanced Q\&A, edge cases, Offer office hours or follow\-ups for complex topics


**Technical Skills:** 
  

  

* Experience contributing to at least one Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDL) program, either as a security architect, security champion, or similar role.
* Working knowledge of general principles of application security
* Working knowledge of threat modeling principles.
* Working Knowledge of security standards (OWASP, ISO, NIST, ...).
* Knowledge of security regulations, such as the Radio Equipment Directive (RED), Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS), and Common Criteria (CC) or equivalent.
* Good understanding of cryptographic principles, including algorithms, key management, and protocols.
* Experience using security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, Vulnerability Scanners, Secret Scanners).
* Hands\-on experience in at least one, preferably more, of these application domains:
+ Embedded device Security
+ Mobile security
+ Web \& API security
+ Desktop security.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cloud infrastructure, Supply Chain, and deployment Security
* Experience with Agile/SAFe Methodology
* Experience with usage of AI tools in the context of a security program.


**Education And/or Experience**
* Master's Degree, computer science, or similar qualifications.
* At least 3 years in software/product security, application security, or security architecture
* At least 7 years of hands\-on software engineering / QA / DevOps earlier in career (or equivalent).
* At least one security or privacy certification (CISSP, CIPT, CSSLP, CEH, ...) is a plus.
* Proven ownership of at least one of: threat modeling program, secure design review governance, audit evidence management, security tooling strategy, penetration testing program or similar.


**Soft Skills**
* Ability to effectively communicate complex concepts clearly and effectively in the English language, both verbally and in writing.
* Like training and knowledge\-sharing, with a strong motivation to ensure the security program is successfully implemented by the teams.
* Highly adaptable and approachable, fostering collaboration and open communication.
* Ability to tailor your communication to different audiences such as product owners, development teams, architects, and other high\-level users.
* Strong technical acumen with the ability to engage effectively with development teams and Continuous learning mindset.


****Why apply?****
* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part\-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results\-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves to feel appreciated and accepted.


 This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
   

  

 HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.
   

  

**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
 On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
   

  

 When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: SAP ABAP TM
description:
**Job Summary**
 The consultant is responsible for analyzing banking legal and payment requirements designing the payment file structure using transaction DMEE/DMEEX and ensuring seamless integration with the SAP Automatic Payment Program (F110/F111\).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* DMEE Tree Design \& Configuration\- Build and maintain custom DMEE tree structures (PAYM SWIFT SEPA) to meet specific banking format requirements.
* Bank Communication Support\- Collaborate with treasury/AP teams and banking partners to define file layouts mapping data from SAP to bank\-required formats.
* Field Mapping \& Logic\- Map SAP structures (FPAYH FPAYHX FPAYP) to file nodes including constants aggregation (e.g. total amount) and conditions.
* Exit Modules Implementation\- Work with ABAP developers to create and assign user exits (e.g. ZDMEE\_EXIT\_TEMPLATE\_ABA) for complex logic that cannot be achieved via standard configuration.
* PMW Configuration\- Configure Payment Medium Workbench (OBPM1 OBPM2 OBPM3 OBPM4\) to link payment methods to DMEE formats.
* Testing \& Troubleshooting\- Perform unit testing troubleshoot payment file errors using DMEE trace tools and assist in User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* S/4HANA Migration\- Upgrade traditional RFFO\* programs to modern DMEEX/PMW structures.


**Technical Skills Required**
* Expertise in DMEE/DMEEX\- Hands\-on experience with transaction codes DMEE/DMEEX.
* Understanding of PMW\- In\-depth knowledge of Payment Medium Workbench (OBPM1\-OBPM4\).
* Data Structures\- Knowledge of SAP payment tables (FPAYH \- Payment Header FPAYP \- Payment Items).
* Technical Familiarity\- Understanding of XML flat file formats and basic ABAP for Debugging/Exit Modules.
* Functional Knowledge\- Strong knowledge of SAP FICO (Accounts Payable Cash Management Bank Accounting).

This individual, working closely with the study team will be responsible for review and acceptance of contract research organization (CRO) deliverables which are mainly, but not limited to, datasets in submission ready standard format (ADaM), tables, figures, listings and submission packages. Principal Statistical Programmer will provide expertise in the design, development and quality control process for SAS programs used to access, extract, transform, review, analyze and submit clinical data for all requested analyses

* Hands on programming role, supporting deliverables in the study/project/portfolio/standards team, of medium or high complex statistical programming deliverables.

* Accountable for their assigned work supporting the standards/study deliverables and also assisting SPLs with the team assignments.

* Ensures appropriate documentation are completed for their deliverables and the deliverables within the team.

* Bachelor or Master (preferred) Degree in Statistics, Biological Sciences, IT, or related field.
* At least 7 years relevant experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO, or Regulatory Agency.
* Statistical Programming and SAS hand\-on experience.
* Clinical trials expertise with an understanding of data operations required for the reporting of clinical trial data.

* Ability to Identify and solve complex problems.

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python\-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.
* Exposure to SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CISSP, CISM, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Azure AI or Google ML certifications is preferred.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services or large enterprise environment is a plus.


**What We Offer You**

Job Title: Analyst \- PowerBI Developer
   

  

 GCL:C3
   

  

**Introduction To Role**
 Are you ready to turn complex commercial data into clear decisions that accelerate access to life\-changing medicines? Join our Chennai\-based reporting and analytics team to engineer enterprise\-grade Power BI solutions that scale across dozens of markets and drive faster, smarter decisions for the business and, ultimately, for patients.
   

  

 Here you will own impactful solutions end\-to\-end, from requirements discovery to production support, translating real\-world objectives into robust, secure, and high\-performing data products. You will contribute to setting engineering standards, optimise semantic models, and advance automation and reuse so our delivery teams move with pace and consistency. Do you thrive in fast paced, high\-performing teams and enjoy mentoring others while improving the standard r on quality?
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Solution Ownership: Lead the design, development, deployment, and support of secure, scalable, high\-performing Power BI solutions that turn commercial and omnichannel data into actionable insight.
* Semantic Modelling and Performance: Build and optimise star\-schema models, calculations, and DAX to deliver fast, reliable analytics at enterprise scale.
* Engineering Standards and Reuse: Define and promote standards, templates, and automation to increase consistency, reduce cycle time, and improve maintainability across reports and models.
* Data Quality and Governance: Ensure accuracy, accessibility, and actionability through rigorous source\-to\-report reconciliation, row\-level security, lineage tracking, and regulated dissemination procedures.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to business users, analysts, data engineers, governance teams, and delivery partners, translating objectives into technical designs with clear trade\-offs.
* Mentoring and Reviews: Coach developers, lead design and code reviews, and cultivate a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
* Operational Excellence: Manage delivery workflows, gateways, and refresh strategies; diagnose and resolve issues related to reports, models, and security throughout the entire flow to keep solutions reliable.
* Agile Delivery: Estimate work, manage dependencies and risks, run UAT, and deliver several projects simultaneously in Agile or Scrum environments.
* Omnichannel Insight Enablement: Interpret campaign and channel metrics to generate insights that improve customer engagement and commercial impact across markets.


**Essential Skills/Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree
* 4\- 6 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, or data management, with at least 4years of hands\-on Power BI solution delivery.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service, including semantic models, workspaces, apps, deployment pipelines, gateways, scheduled and incremental refresh, and row\-level security.
* Expertise in DAX, Power Query, dimensional modelling, star schemas, calculation design, and performance optimisation for large or complex data models.
* Strong SQL skills and experience integrating data from relational databases, cloud data platforms, APIs, files, and enterprise applications.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot report, model, refresh, gateway, security, and data\-quality issues across the end\-to\-end reporting flow.
* Experience with requirements elicitation, technical design, estimation, documentation, testing, source\-to\-report reconciliation, UAT, deployment, and production support.
* Understanding of enterprise data governance, information security, access controls, data lineage, quality management, and controlled release practices.
* Proven experience leading technical discussions, reviewing builds and code, mentoring developers, and influencing collaborators without direct authority.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, prioritisation, and communication skills, capable of explaining complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Experience delivering multiple initiatives in parallel within Agile or Scrum teams, including risk management, dependency management, and continuous improvement.
* Knowledge of omnichannel, commercial, or digital marketing analytics and experience translating campaign and channel metrics into actionable insights.


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry, particularly commercial or omnichannel reporting.
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable cloud analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, Performance Analyzer, source control, CI/CD, Power Automate, REST APIs, or scripting for administration and automation.
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\) or a relevant Microsoft Fabric certification.
* Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, Agile delivery, technical documentation, and structured knowledge transfer.


 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

 Shift Timing: 12:00 PM to 10:00 PM

 Position ID: J0326\-2348

 We are seeking a hands\-on Enterprise Power BI Architect to define, design, and govern the BI architecture across programs and client accounts. This role focuses on building scalable, secure, and high\-performance reporting solutions that enable data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

 The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineering teams, and delivery leads to translate business needs into enterprise reporting frameworks. The role requires a strong combination of Power BI technical expertise, architectural thinking, governance, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 This is an individual contributor role focused on architecture and delivery oversight, rather than people management.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture \& Solution Design
   

  

 Design, develop, and oversee Power BI dashboards, reports, and paginated reports aligned with business requirements.
   

  

 Define and maintain enterprise\-level Power BI architecture standards, patterns, and best practices.
   

  

 Architect scalable semantic models, reusable data models, and enterprise reporting frameworks.
   

  

 Establish reusable data models, KPI frameworks, and visualization standards across domains.
   

  

 Define and enforce data security strategies, including Row\-Level Security (RLS), access governance, and workspace security.
   

  

 Drive performance optimization across datasets, data models, reports, and enterprise workspaces.
   

  

 Optimize data models, datasets, and report performance for enterprise\-scale deployments.
   

  

 Governance \& Strategy
   

  

 Define and enforce BI governance standards including naming conventions, workspace strategy, and deployment pipelines.
   

  

 Collaborate with data engineering teams to align reporting with data warehouse, lakehouse, and analytics platforms.
   

  

 Evaluate existing reporting solutions and recommend modernization and architecture improvements.
   

  

 Ensure data governance, compliance, and security standards are maintained.
   

  

 Act as a steward for analytics platform maturity and standardization across accounts.
   

  

 Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership
   

  

 Lead architecture discussions with business stakeholders, program leaders, and clients.
   

  

 Translate business strategy and analytical needs into actionable reporting and architecture roadmaps.
   

  

 Clearly articulate trade\-offs, risks, scalability considerations, and remediation strategies to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 Provide solution architecture support for presales, estimations, and strategic initiatives.
   

  

 Delivery Enablement \& Team Leadership
   

  

 Guide BI developers and tech leads on data modeling, DAX optimization, and Power BI best practices.
   

  

 Conduct architecture reviews, design validations, and solution quality assessments.
   

  

 Enable DevOps, CI/CD, automation, and monitoring practices for Power BI solutions.
   

  

 Mentor teams and promote enterprise BI delivery maturity and technical excellence.
   

  

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

 8\+ years of experience in Business Intelligence / Data Analytics.
   

  

 5\+ years of hands\-on Power BI experience in enterprise environments.
   

  

 Design, develop, and oversee interactive Power BI dashboards, reports, and paginated reports.
   

  

 Strong expertise in:
   

  

 Advanced data modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake, Composite Models)
   

  

 DAX optimization and performance tuning
   

  

 Power Query / data transformation
   

  

 Row\-Level Security (RLS) and Power BI governance
   

  

 Strong SQL skills with understanding of data warehouse architecture.
   

  

 Experience with Azure / SQL Server\-based analytics platforms.
   

  

 Experience implementing DevOps / CI\-CD pipelines for Power BI.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder communication and architectural leadership capabilities.
   

  

 Good to Have
   

  

 Experience with Microsoft Fabric.
   

  

 Exposure to data lakes, lakehouse architecture, and modern analytics platforms.

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**

title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Our Mission:**
 We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.
   

  

**About Us**
 Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.


**Test Strategy \& Coverage**
* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.


**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**
* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.


**Functional \& Workflow Testing**
* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.


**XML and Publishing Validation**
* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.


**Data Layer Testing**
* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.


**API and Integration Testing**
* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.


**Performance and Reliability Testing**
* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.


**Collaboration \& Execution**
* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.


**Experience And Skills**
**Mandatory Requirements \& Qualifications** 
 :
   

  

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands\-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven, and webhook\-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor’s in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications**
* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG \& EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.
* Exposure to cloud\-based testing environments (AWS/Azure).
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

title: Converter Software Engineer - Specialist
description:
**Vestas is well\-known in wind technology and actively contributes to its development. Vestas’ core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of Wind Turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!**
**Power \> Power Controls \> Converter Control Framework**
 The Converter Control department plays a key role in maintaining Vestas' leadership in sustainable energy. Our team develops, maintains, and assures the quality of converter control functionalities for all Vestas turbine families, while ensuring full compliance with global grid code requirements.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to join our Converter Control Department, developing next\-generation control platforms for utility\-scale wind turbines.
   

  

 You will play a key role in designing and implementing software that controls high\-power converters, enabling reliable and efficient renewable energy generation. Working closely with control engineers, system architects, platform teams, and test engineers, you will help translate advanced control concepts into robust, production\-ready embedded solutions.
   

  

 This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex real\-time challenges, helping guide technical decisions, and mentoring colleagues while remaining directly involved in software development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop embedded software for converter control systems
* Contribute to software architecture and long\-term platform evolution
* Ensure software quality, maintainability, and scalability across multiple product generations
* Review designs and code to ensure adherence to engineering standards
* Develop and maintain real\-time embedded applications in C/C\+\+
* Implement control\-oriented software running on DSPs, microcontrollers, or industrial embedded platforms
* Optimize software performance, determinism, memory usage, and execution time
* Debug complex issues across software, hardware, and system interfaces
* Support system integration, validation, and commissioning activities while developing automated tests and verification strategies
* Contribute to SIL, HIL, and system\-level validation activities while analyzing field issues and supporting root\-cause investigations


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Embedded Software / Electronics / Similar specialization
* 10 \+ years of experience with embedded software development environments
* Good understanding of software configuration management and version control
* Proficiency with industry tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
* Knowledge of software integration and release processes
* Ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering teams
* Skilled at diagnosing issues and developing practical solutions


**Competencies**
* Ability to work on their own through complex technical problems
* Experience working with remote, multi\-location teams
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills
* Possesses a global mindset with deep cultural understanding
* Applies a systems engineering approach to problem\-solving and decision\-making
* Results\-oriented, receptive to different perspectives, and thrives in an international, multicultural environment
* Mentors junior and mid\-level engineers
* Shares best practices in embedded development and software engineering
* Supports continuous improvement in development processes and tools


**What We Offer**
 We offer you a job in a truly global and collaborative organization with great opportunities for cross\-disciplinary and personal development, where emphasis is placed on the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. You will benefit from a collaborative, professional atmosphere supported by great technical skill and an inspiring culture. You will be directly involved in facilitating the development of a core product and service, which is of utmost importance to our customers.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Your primary workplace will be Vestas India, Chennai.
   

  

 Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including before the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 15th October 2026\.
   

  

**Our commitment to a fair hiring**
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
   

  

**DEIB Statement**
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
   

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our\-recruitment\-process
   

  

**About Vestas**
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
   

  

 Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40\+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.

* 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong exposure to GenAI, LLMs, platform engineering, and backend development.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Python for AI application development and backend engineering.
* Experience building LLM\-powered applications, RAG systems, agentic workflows, prompt engineering solutions, and enterprise AI integrations.
* Hands\-on proficiency with LangChain, LangGraph, and exposure to AutoGen, Google Agent SDK, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or skills\-based agent frameworks.

* Lead the resolution of network performance issues through strategic coordination across internal teams and provide expert technical support for airline performance and customer escalations to SES’s customer\-facing teams.
* Independently educate and manage internal and external stakeholders on performance metrics such as Latency, Speed, Packet Loss, Jitter, and the utilization of managed service fabric. Provide strategic guidance to ensure stakeholders have a clear understanding and alignment with organizational objectives.
* Lead comprehensive reviews and analyses of existing data collection systems. Provide strategic recommendations on improvements, maintenance, or other factors to significantly enhance system performance, reliability, and efficiency.

**You should have:**
* System thinking skills for isolating issues within a complex network
* BS degree in Engineering/Computer Science disciplines
* 10\+ years of system level troubleshooting experience working on complex systems
* 5 years of relevant experience in the satellite and/or telecommunications industry
* TCP/IP, Linux/Shell Scripting, Packet Capture/WireShark, Jira, Wiki, Test Director
* JQL, SQL, Python, Java, Go, Git, Jenkins (CI), Spinnaker (CD), AWS OpenSearch
* Tableau, Power BI, Network Analysis
* Excellent Verbal/written communication skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong understanding of capacity and time management
* Flexibility to work occasional weekends or off hours, as emergencies arise
* Proactively seek continuous learning and continuous improvements
* Mentor new members and create personal development goals


**It would be nice if you had:**
* Strong networking background with CCNA/CCNE certifications
* Working knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe PI), DevOps and SRE
* Exceptional techno\-commercial business acumen in satellite communication network rollout, influencing strategic decisions and project success.
* Advanced technical competency in VSAT Network Platform operation methodologies and mastery of TDMA systems such as Gilat with comprehensive knowledge of their functionality, performance, and system operations.


**What it’s like to work with us:**
 Intelsat is connecting the world and transforming the satellite and inflight connectivity landscape by reaching beyond the traditional satellite industry. We connect the aviation industry and air travelers with innovative technology and applications, and we do it all in a high\-energy environment that welcomes the next challenge. title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job title:** 
 Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Manager, IT Systems Administration
   

  

**Contract:** 
 Permanent, Full\-time
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.
   

  

 While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**
* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends


**Cloud Security**
* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments


**Cloud Networking**
* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures


**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**
* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed


**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**
* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments


**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**
* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records


**Minimum**
**What You’ll Need:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.


**Your Advantage**
* Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with IT service management practices (ITIL) and change management processes

* Drive technical decisions and champion an automation\-first, engineering\-led approach across teams.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
   

  

 As a Principal Engineer / architect you will be responsible for creating a technical strategy and coordinating the designs for meeting the needs of Toast’s largest restaurant brands. You will partner with Product Managers to develop the technology roadmap that enables enterprise customers to leverage the power of Toast. You will also work closely with technical leaders and implementation teams across the organization to deliver robust, scalable solutions with integrations to customers’ external systems. While the role is primarily internally\-facing, it requires infrequent interactions with enterprise customers, listening to their requirements and providing expert guidance as they deploy Toast.
   

  

 If you’re a technical leader or a solutions architect, experienced with enterprise SaaS, passionate about customer value, and a great collaborator, read on!
   

  

**A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)**
* Lead the evolution of Toast’s backend architecture, frameworks, and data models with a strong focus on delivery efficiency, system scalability, and resilience.
* Design and build the next generation of accounting and financial systems using Java, Kotlin, DynamoDB, Pulsar, GraphQL, Big Data tools, and more.
* Define and implement scalable engineering practices, delivery frameworks, and coding standards that raise the technical bar across the org.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, UX, QA, and multiple engineering teams to deliver robust, customer\-facing solutions.
* Build and maintain strong partnerships across business units, aligning technology strategies with key company objectives.
* Champion data\-driven decision making by developing strategies and prioritizing initiatives with high impact on user and business outcomes.
* Mentor and grow engineers across levels, promoting a culture of inclusivity, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.
* Guide and influence the broader technical roadmap and architecture strategy for Toast.
* Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building \- contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team


**What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)**
* 12\+ years of experience designing and delivering complex, scalable backend systems.
* Proven technical leadership on mission\-critical projects, with the ability to influence across multiple teams.
* Strong experience building distributed, event\-driven architectures and microservices in Java, Kotlin, Scala, or similar OOP languages.
* Deep understanding of data architecture and schema design; experience with DynamoDB is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Strong knowledge of modern database systems (Postgres, SQL Server, DynamoDB).
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment, delivering value continuously.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to break down complexity and drive solutions that scale.
* A passion for building impactful products with a customer\-first mindset.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills—respectful, empathetic, humble, and inclusive.
* A growth mindset with a desire to constantly learn and uplift others.
* Comfortable balancing velocity with platform stability and long\-term architecture goals.
* Comfortable using AI\-powered engineering tools to improve developer productivity, code quality, and technical decision\-making, with the ability to critically evaluate and validate AI\-generated solutions.
* Demonstrated experience incorporating AI into the software development lifecycle to improve engineering effectiveness, and the ability to champion best practices for responsible, secure, and high\-impact AI adoption across engineering teams.


**AI at Toast**
 At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
   

  

**Our Total Rewards Philosophy**
 We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast\-benefits.
   

  

**How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process**
 Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note\-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real\-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai\-in\-hiring
   

  

**Our Approach to Hybrid Working**
 We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in\-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in\-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations\-toast
   

  

**People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success**
 At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.
   

  

**Apply today!**
 Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

title: HCL WebSphere Commerce Developer
description:
Design, develop (code), test, and debug applications on HD Supply’s B2B eCommerce platform. Provide ready\-to\-serve experience and development subject\-matter expertise across the HCL Commerce / WebSphere Commerce (WCS) v8 storefront and the adjacent Next.js and Spring Boot surfaces that now share customer traffic with it. Maintain, enhance, and deliver solutions for commerce applications. Assist team members and project leads in day\-to\-day project work during dual\-run (legacy commerce engine \+ modern storefront).
 



  





**Major Tasks, Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities** 



* Design and develop application components in an Agile environment — WCS storefront and business logic, Java/Spring Boot services, and Next.js / React storefront work as assigned.
* Participate in gathering requirements, documenting and designing HCL Commerce / WCS functionality and related enhancements. Support application integration testing, integration development, data conversion, and cut\-over activities.
* Design, develop, and implement multi\-tier commerce applications (web and backend) to support B2B business requirements, including punchout and other customer purchasing\-system channels where those flows still run on Commerce.
* Create and review designs; identify re\-usability, performance issues, and best practices for Commerce, REST/SOAP services, and Java.
* Support the full life cycle of storefront pages, store data, store business logic, customization of WebSphere / HCL Commerce tools, and integration with back\-end systems (including services that sit in front of or beside Commerce).
* Implement Java\-based solutions for public\-facing B2B websites based on business requirements; extend or consume Spring Boot APIs that wrap or replace Commerce capabilities as pages move off WCS.
* Contribute to Next.js / React storefront work (pages, data fetching, integration with Commerce or microservice APIs) so migrated and unmigrated journeys stay consistent.
* Perform unit testing before moving code/configuration to QA. Research defects and solve for root cause across WCS, Spring Boot, and Next.js as the defect spans those layers.
* Identify key barriers and core problems; apply problem\-solving skills to complex situations. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a dual\-run architecture (legacy Commerce runtime plus modern storefront).



  





**Skills and Qualifications** 




**Required** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent work experience (4\+ years professional).
* 5\+ years expertise in HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x — store customization, business logic, tools, catalog/order/user flows, and integration with back\-end systems. v8 experience is the hiring bar; later Commerce versions are a plus, not a substitute.
* 5\+ years Java development and OOD skills on large IT systems (J2EE on WebSphere Application Server strongly preferred).
* 3\+ years Spring / Spring MVC; hands\-on Spring Boot (REST APIs, service integration) required — not “Spring on a résumé only.”
* 5\+ years web services (REST and SOAP).
* 5\+ years source control (Git required; SVN/CVS acceptable as prior experience).
* 3\+ years JavaScript, HTML, CSS; Next.js and React experience required (production storefront or equivalent, not tutorials\-only). TypeScript preferred.
* Experience with Agile delivery using Atlassian tools (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence).
* Strong communication skills; proven team player.



  





**Preferred** 



* B2B commerce, punchout, and/or mobile commerce business models.
* Headless or composable commerce patterns (API\-first storefront consuming Commerce or BFF/microservices). MuleSoft or similar iPaaS is a plus, not required.
* Additional JS frameworks (Angular, Vue) as secondary experience.
* Exposure to search (Solr), session/page cache (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts (e.g. Optimizely or equivalent) alongside a commerce engine.
* Experience working Preview vs Runtime (authoring/preview vs customer\-facing) Commerce stacks without treating them as the same environment.

 Event\-driven and streaming data architectures
   

  

 Event sourcing and state\-transition modeling
   

  

 Idempotent, replay\-safe, and failure\-tolerant data pipelines
   

  

 Designing systems for high TPS and frequent state updates
   

  

 Multi\-region data design and disaster recovery

 Redis for low\-latency caching, counters, and ephemeral state

 Low\-Level Design (LLD) for scalable, fault\-tolerant components

 NoSQL stores for hot state (e.g., Mongo, DynamoDB, Cassandra)
   

  

 Relational databases for reference/config data
   

  

 Data lake query engines (Athena, Spark)

 Containerized runtimes and cloud\-native deployments

 Define and lead a multi\-year technical vision for AI applications and platforms, aligning technology choices to business outcomes and total cost of ownership.

 Scan emerging technologies (e.g., multimodal models, agentic workflows, vector databases, privacy\-preserving ML), run targeted pilots, and transition validated innovations into production\-ready standards.

In this role, you will work as a key technical contributor within the controls team, partnering with cross\-functional teams to develop reliable and effective control solutions that support system performance, safety, and grid integration. This position is intended for an engineer with solid technical experience who can work independently on defined problems and contribute to broader team objectives.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement control strategies for inverter\-based solar and energy storage systems, including coordination with battery management systems (BMS), power conversion systems (PCS), and plant\-level controls.
* Support design, tuning, and testing of inverter control algorithms to meet performance, reliability, safety, and grid compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with systems, software, product, and field teams to clarify requirements and support successful integration of control solutions.
* Perform verification and validation activities for controls functions using standard engineering tools.
* Assist with product and project execution activities from development through commissioning, including troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation such as control logic descriptions, specifications, test procedures, and validation results.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective actions for control\-related issues identified during testing or field operation.
* Work with experienced engineers to improve controls performance, development processes, and product quality.
* Stay informed on applicable industry standards, grid requirements, and control technologies relevant to inverter\-based systems.


**Required Qualifications**
